per:0.line: 'One fragment *per* second — stay still and do not breathe.'

sentences.en: The old port district never slept.
sentences.cn: 老港口区从不入眠。

sentences.en: Cranes, smoke, and the low groan of machines filled the wet air.
sentences.cn: 起重机、烟雾和机器的低沉呻吟充满了湿漉漉的空气。

sentences.en: Grey Crow called this stretch the *industry* belt — every warehouse here belonged to Zero's network.
Ali tugged my sleeve and pointed at a crate stamped with a signal logo I had seen in the encrypted files.
sentences.cn: 阿栗拉了拉我的袖子，指向一个装着标志的板条箱，那个标志我在加密文件里见过。

concern:1.en: Ali met me under the broken overpass. Her face was tight. 'My *concern* is not the rain or the patrol drones,' she said, scanning the empty street. 'It is that Zero already knows we are here.' She held up her wrist scanner. The screen showed two signals — ours, and one other, closing fast.
concern:1.cnHint: 阿栗表示她真正的____不是雨或无人机，而是零点已经知道我们在这里。
concern:1.hook: The second signal stopped — right outside our hiding spot.
concern:1.line: 'My real *concern* is that we have been tracked from the start.'

sentences.en: Ali met me under the broken overpass.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在破损的立交桥下和我见面。

sentences.en: Her face was tight.
sentences.cn: 她的脸绷得很紧。

sentences.en: 'My *concern* is not the rain or the patrol drones,' she said, scanning the empty street.
'It is that Zero already knows we are here.'
sentences.cn: 零点已经知道我们在这里了。

sentences.en: She held up her wrist scanner.
sentences.cn: 她举起手腕上的扫描仪。

sentences.en: The screen showed two signals — ours, and one other, closing fast.
sentences.cn: 屏幕上显示两个信号——我们的，还有另一个，正在快速逼近。

present:1.en: The neon market was loud and crowded, a perfect place to hide. Grey Crow was not *present* — he had gone dark two hours ago. Ali bought a paper cup of tea and passed it to me without a word. Somewhere in the noise, a voice said my code name, clear as a bell.
present:1.cnHint: 灰鸦不在____场，阿栗递给我一杯茶，人群中却突然有人喊出了我的代号。
present:1.hook: I did not know that voice, but it knew me well.
present:1.line: 'Grey Crow is not *present*, so you answer to me now.'

sentences.en: The neon market was loud and crowded, a perfect place to hide.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯市场人声鼎沸，是藏身的完美地点。

sentences.en: Grey Crow was not *present* — he had gone dark two hours ago.
Ali bought a paper cup of tea and passed it to me without a word.
sentences.cn: 阿栗买了一杯纸质茶杯，没说一句话就递给了我。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the noise, a voice said my code name, clear as a bell.
sentences.cn: 在噪声中的某个地方，有人用清晰刺耳的声音说出了我的代号。

claim:1.en: A stranger in a grey coat stepped from a doorway. He held up a cracked data card. 'I *claim* this card gives me full rights to the East Tower transmitter,' he said, his eyes never blinking. Ali shook her head slowly behind him. The data card's serial number matched one reported stolen from my own file.
claim:1.cnHint: 一个陌生人____这张卡赋予他东塔发射机的完整权限，而卡的序列号竟与我档案中失窃的记录吻合。
claim:1.hook: He smiled, and I realised he had been waiting for me.
claim:1.line: 'I *claim* this tower, this signal, and everything in it.'

sentences.en: A stranger in a grey coat stepped from a doorway.
sentences.cn: 一个穿着灰色外套的陌生人从门口走了出来。

sentences.en: He held up a cracked data card.
sentences.cn: 他举起一张裂纹数据卡。

sentences.en: 'I *claim* this card gives me full rights to the East Tower transmitter,' he said, his eyes never blinking.
Ali shook her head slowly behind him.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在他身后慢慢摇了摇头。

sentences.en: The data card's serial number matched one reported stolen from my own file.
sentences.cn: 这张数据卡的序列号和一张从我自己档案里被盗报告的相符。

half:1.en: The checkpoint light turned red. The guard checked my pass for what felt like an hour, then handed back only *half* of it — the part with my real name was gone. I looked at Ali across the barrier. She mouthed one word: Zero. The crowd behind me pushed forward, and the gate slammed shut.
half:1.cnHint: 检查站的警卫只还给我____通行证，另一半——写有我真实姓名的那部分——不见了。
half:1.hook: Without that half, I no longer existed in the city's records.
half:1.line: 'They kept the other *half* — the half that proves who you are.'

sentences.en: The checkpoint light turned red.
sentences.cn: 检查站的灯变红了。

sentences.en: The guard checked my pass for what felt like an hour, then handed back only *half* of it — the part with my real name was gone.
I looked at Ali across the barrier.
sentences.cn: 我看着屏障另一边的阿栗。

sentences.en: She mouthed one word: Zero.
sentences.cn: 她用嘴型说了一个词：零点。

sentences.en: The crowd behind me pushed forward, and the gate slammed shut.
sentences.cn: 我身后的人群向前推挤，大门砰地关上了。

successful:1.en: Grey Crow lit a cigarette outside the relay station. 'Every *successful* break-in Zero has done began on this street,' he said, pointing to the drain at the corner. I crouched and looked. A thin wire ran from the drain into the station wall — live, still warm. Zero had already been here tonight.
successful:1.cnHint: 灰鸦说零点每一次____的入侵都从这条街开始，而那根细线证明他今晚已经来过了。
successful:1.hook: The wire was still warm — Zero had left only minutes ago.
successful:1.line: 'Not one *successful* move of his started anywhere else.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow lit a cigarette outside the relay station.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在中继站外点了根烟。

sentences.en: 'Every *successful* break-in Zero has done began on this street,' he said, pointing to the drain at the corner.
I crouched and looked.
sentences.cn: 我蹲下身看了看。

sentences.en: A thin wire ran from the drain into the station wall — live, still warm.
sentences.cn: 一根细导线从下水道伸进站房的墙里——还通着电，温热的。

sentences.en: Zero had already been here tonight.
sentences.cn: 零点今晚已经来过这里了。

access:1.en: The side door had no handle, only a code pad slick with rain. Ali hacked it in thirty seconds flat. 'I have *access*,' she said quietly, stepping inside. The corridor beyond was empty, but every wall screen was on, every camera turning toward us at the same moment, as if something had been expecting two visitors.
access:1.cnHint: 阿栗在三十秒内破解了密码，获得了进入权限，但走廊里的所有摄像头同时转向了我们。
access:1.hook: Every camera turned at once — nothing does that by accident.
access:1.line: 'I have *access*, but something in here already knows it.'

sentences.en: The side door had no handle, only a code pad slick with rain.
sentences.cn: 侧门没有把手，只有一个被雨水浸湿的代码键盘。

sentences.en: Ali hacked it in thirty seconds flat.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在三十秒内破解了它。

sentences.en: 'I have *access*,' she said quietly, stepping inside.
The corridor beyond was empty, but every wall screen was on, every camera turning toward us at the same moment, as if something had been expecting two visitors.
sentences.cn: 走廊那边空荡荡的，但每面墙上的屏幕都亮着，每个摄像头同时转向我们，仿佛什么东西一直在等待两个访客。

positive:1.en: The rain hammered the stone steps outside Central Gate. Grey Crow pressed a small device into my hand. 'The signal is clean,' he said. His voice was flat, but his eyes carried something *positive*—a steady belief that we could still fix what Zero had broken in this city.
positive:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在中央门外向我传递装置，眼神中透着一种____的力量。
positive:1.hook: But the device flickered once, then went dark.
positive:1.line: 'Stay *positive*—doubt is the first door Zero opens.'

sentences.en: The rain hammered the stone steps outside Central Gate.
sentences.cn: 雨猛烈地敲打着中央门外的石阶。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a small device into my hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一个小装置塞进了我的手里。

sentences.en: 'The signal is clean,' he said.
sentences.cn: 信号很干净，他说。

sentences.en: His voice was flat, but his eyes carried something *positive*—a steady belief that we could still fix what Zero had broken in this city.

economic:1.en: Neon signs buzzed above the flooded market street. I pulled up the city grid on my lens. Every *economic* line in Harbor City ran through one encrypted node—food, power, trade. Zero had found that node. If it fell, the whole city would starve before dawn.
economic:1.cnHint: 我在市场街发现，港城所有____命脉都汇聚在一个加密节点。
economic:1.hook: The node's signal just moved—closer to us.
economic:1.line: 'Every *economic* line in this city feeds that one point.'

sentences.en: Neon signs buzzed above the flooded market street.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯在被洪水淹没的市场街道上嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: I pulled up the city grid on my lens.
sentences.cn: 我在镜片上调出了城市网格。

sentences.en: Every *economic* line in Harbor City ran through one encrypted node—food, power, trade.
Zero had found that node.
sentences.cn: 零点找到了那个节点。

sentences.en: If it fell, the whole city would starve before dawn.
sentences.cn: 如果它崩溃了，整个城市在天亮前就会陷入饥荒。

link:1.en: Ali crouched beside a broken street lamp, her fingers tracing wet graffiti on the wall. 'There,' she whispered. A single painted ring—the *link* between Zero's two cells. Find who drew it, and the whole chain breaks. Around us, rain erased footprints fast.
link:1.cnHint: 阿里在街灯旁的涂鸦中发现了两个犯罪团伙之间的关键____。
link:1.hook: The paint was still wet—someone had been here seconds ago.
link:1.line: 'This ring is the *link*—break it and Zero falls apart.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside a broken street lamp, her fingers tracing wet graffiti on the wall.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在一盏破损的街灯旁，手指划过墙上湿漉漉的涂鸦。

sentences.en: 'There,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: 有了，她低声说。

sentences.en: A single painted ring—the *link* between Zero's two cells.
Find who drew it, and the whole chain breaks.
sentences.cn: 找到画这个的人，整条链就会断裂。

sentences.en: Around us, rain erased footprints fast.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，雨水快速冲掉了足迹。

produce:1.en: I watched the old print shop on Deck Nine from across the slick street. Every night it claimed to *produce* paper maps for tourists. But the lights inside burned until three in the morning. No tourist shop works those hours. Something else was being made in there.
produce:1.cnHint: 第九层甲板上的印刷店声称____旅游地图，但我注意到它的灯光整夜不灭。
produce:1.hook: Then a shadow crossed the window—too tall to be the owner.
produce:1.line: 'They don't *produce* maps in there—they print orders for Zero.'

sentences.en: I watched the old print shop on Deck Nine from across the slick street.
sentences.cn: 我从对面潮湿的街道上盯着九号甲板上那家老印刷厂。

sentences.en: Every night it claimed to *produce* paper maps for tourists.
But the lights inside burned until three in the morning.
sentences.cn: 但里面的灯一直亮到凌晨三点。

sentences.en: No tourist shop works those hours.
sentences.cn: 没有旅游商店会营业到这么晚。

sentences.en: Something else was being made in there.
sentences.cn: 有什么别的东西在那里面被制造出来。

teach:1.en: Grey Crow stopped at the mouth of Copper Alley and pointed to the coded signs above each door. 'Let me *teach* you how Zero marks safe houses,' he said quietly. Each symbol looked like a simple weather mark to most people. To us, they were a map of danger.
teach:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在铜巷口停下，要____我辨认零的安全屋暗号。
teach:1.hook: The third door bore no mark at all—that was the real warning.
teach:1.line: 'I will *teach* you this once—after that, you read them alone.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped at the mouth of Copper Alley and pointed to the coded signs above each door.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在铜巷口停下，指向每扇门上方的密码符号。

sentences.en: 'Let me *teach* you how Zero marks safe houses,' he said quietly.
Each symbol looked like a simple weather mark to most people.
sentences.cn: 对大多数人来说，每个符号看起来就像简单的天气标记。

sentences.en: To us, they were a map of danger.
sentences.cn: 对我们来说，它们是危险的地图。

worth:1.en: Ali held up a small data chip she had pulled from a drain beside the night market. 'Is it *worth* anything?' I asked. She turned it slowly under a neon light. The chip was scratched and wet, but the code stamped on its edge made my breath stop cold.
worth:1.cnHint: 阿里在夜市旁的排水沟里捡到一枚芯片，我们判断它是否____冒险一查。
worth:1.hook: That code matched the one Grey Crow told us to fear most.
worth:1.line: 'Trust me—this chip is *worth* every risk we just took.'

sentences.en: Ali held up a small data chip she had pulled from a drain beside the night market.
sentences.cn: 阿栗举起一枚从夜市旁沟渠里掏出来的小数据芯片。

sentences.en: 'Is it *worth* anything?'
I asked.
sentences.cn: 我问。

sentences.en: She turned it slowly under a neon light.
sentences.cn: 她在霓虹灯下缓缓转动它。

sentences.en: The chip was scratched and wet, but the code stamped on its edge made my breath stop cold.
sentences.cn: 芯片又脏又湿，但边缘打下的代码让我的呼吸一下子冻住了。

common:1.en: Zero left no grand signs. That was the *common* truth every investigator in Harbor City learned too late—his marks were plain, small, and easy to miss. A chalk dot. A bent antenna. I stood at the crossroads and finally saw them everywhere around me.
common:1.cnHint: 在港城十字路口，我终于明白零的行事方式有一个____规律。
common:1.hook: Every mark pointed toward the building directly behind me.
common:1.line: 'It is a *common* trick—hide the biggest secret in plain sight.'

sentences.en: Zero left no grand signs.
sentences.cn: 零点不留下宏大的标记。

sentences.en: That was the *common* truth every investigator in Harbor City learned too late—his marks were plain, small, and easy to miss.
A chalk dot.
sentences.cn: 一个粉笔点。

sentences.en: A bent antenna.
sentences.cn: 一根弯曲的天线。

sentences.en: I stood at the crossroads and finally saw them everywhere around me.
sentences.cn: 我站在十字路口，终于看到它们在我周围无处不在。

daily:1.en: The old woman at the corner stall sold hot broth every morning without fail. Grey Crow said her *daily* route was the one fixed point Zero never touched. So we used it—met beside her cart at six, passed notes through the steam, then split before sunrise hit the water.
daily:1.cnHint: 那位老妇人____出摊的路线，成了我们在零的眼皮下传递情报的掩护。
daily:1.hook: This morning her cart was gone—and so was Grey Crow.
daily:1.line: 'Her *daily* route is the one thread Zero cannot cut—yet.'

sentences.en: The old woman at the corner stall sold hot broth every morning without fail.
sentences.cn: 角落里的老妇人每天早上从不间断地卖热汤。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said her *daily* route was the one fixed point Zero never touched.
So we used it—met beside her cart at six, passed notes through the steam, then split before sunrise hit the water.
sentences.cn: 我们就利用了这一点——六点时在她的推车边见面，在蒸汽里传递纸条，日出前就各自散开。

determine:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Gate Nine. Grey Crow crouched beside a smashed signal box, tracing burnt wires with one finger. 'We need to *determine* whether Zero cut this line before or after the blackout,' he said. Ali checked her watch. Forty seconds of silence followed.
determine:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在破损的信号箱旁，试图____断电线被切断的时间。
determine:1.hook: The answer would change everything we thought we knew.
determine:1.line: 'We must *determine* which side cut the line first.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Gate Nine.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着九号门外的破裂街道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow crouched beside a smashed signal box, tracing burnt wires with one finger.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在一个被砸毁的信号箱旁，用一根手指追踪烧焦的电线。

sentences.en: 'We need to *determine* whether Zero cut this line before or after the blackout,' he said.
Ali checked her watch.
sentences.cn: 阿栗查了查手表。

sentences.en: Forty seconds of silence followed.
sentences.cn: 四十秒的沉默随之而来。

response:1.en: I called out the access code at the checkpoint gate. Nothing. I tried again, louder this time, voice steady despite the cold rain soaking my collar. Still no *response* came from the guard post. The screen above the gate flickered once, then went dark. Ali grabbed my arm.
response:1.cnHint: 我在关卡门口呼叫口令，却迟迟得不到任何____。
response:1.hook: Someone had cleared the post — but left the lights on.
response:1.line: 'No *response* means they are already watching us.'

sentences.en: I called out the access code at the checkpoint gate.
sentences.cn: 我在检查站大门口喊出了通行密码。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.cn: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: I tried again, louder this time, voice steady despite the cold rain soaking my collar.
sentences.cn: 我又试了一次，这次更大声，声音平稳，尽管冷雨浸透了我的衣领。

sentences.en: Still no *response* came from the guard post.
The screen above the gate flickered once, then went dark.
sentences.cn: 大门上方的屏幕闪烁了一下，然后熄灭了。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

search:1.en: Patrol drones swept low over the wet street in a slow grid pattern. Grey Crow pressed us flat against a cold wall. 'This *search* pattern means Zero knows we pulled the file,' he whispered. Above us, a lens rotated. The beam passed one centimetre from my boot.
search:1.cnHint: 无人机正在街道上空展开____，灰鸦认出了这个飞行规律。
search:1.hook: One wrong step and the beam would lock on us.
search:1.line: 'A *search* this wide means Zero is already afraid.'

sentences.en: Patrol drones swept low over the wet street in a slow grid pattern.
sentences.cn: 巡逻无人机在湿润的街道上缓缓以网格方式扫过。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed us flat against a cold wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我们压贴在冰冷的墙上。

sentences.en: 'This *search* pattern means Zero knows we pulled the file,' he whispered.
Above us, a lens rotated.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，一个镜头旋转了。

sentences.en: The beam passed one centimetre from my boot.
sentences.cn: 光束从我的靴子前一厘米处掠过。

due:1.en: The freight lift at Dock Seven was supposed to arrive at midnight. It was now three minutes past and the platform stood empty. *Due* to a rerouted power line, every clock on the block was running slow — or so the official notice read. Ali did not believe it.
due:1.cnHint: 由于线路被改道，七号码头的货运升降机____晚点了，但阿里觉得没那么简单。
due:1.hook: Slow clocks are useful when you need to hide a body.
due:1.line: '*Due* to that detour, someone bought themselves ten minutes.'

sentences.en: The freight lift at Dock Seven was supposed to arrive at midnight.
sentences.cn: 七号码头的货运电梯应该在午夜到达。

sentences.en: It was now three minutes past and the platform stood empty.
sentences.cn: 现在已经过了三分钟，月台空荡荡的。

sentences.en: *Due* to a rerouted power line, every clock on the block was running slow — or so the official notice read.
Ali did not believe it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗不相信这种说法。

regard:1.en: Grey Crow stepped into the orange light and the street crowd parted without a word. Everyone seemed to *regard* him as someone powerful and a little dangerous, though he wore no badge. He stopped at the corner and looked back at me once, eyes steady. I followed without question.
regard:1.cnHint: 街上的人们都以某种敬畏的眼光____灰鸦，他不动声色地向我示意跟上。
regard:1.hook: Even Zero's lookout stepped aside to let him pass.
regard:1.line: 'They *regard* him as untouchable — use that while it lasts.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stepped into the orange light and the street crowd parted without a word.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦步入橙色的灯光，街道上的人群无言地分开。

sentences.en: Everyone seemed to *regard* him as someone powerful and a little dangerous, though he wore no badge.
He stopped at the corner and looked back at me once, eyes steady.
sentences.cn: 他在角落停下，回头看了我一眼，眼神平静坚定。

sentences.en: I followed without question.
sentences.cn: 我没有疑问地跟了上去。

true:1.en: Zero had left a message burned into the wall near the underpass: a single line of code that looked like noise. I ran the filter Grey Crow taught me. The *true* text surfaced — a time, a place, and my own badge number. My hands went cold.
true:1.cnHint: 地下通道旁的涂鸦看似乱码，但过滤后____的内容让我不寒而栗。
true:1.hook: Zero had known my number before I was ever assigned this case.
true:1.line: 'The *true* message was meant for you alone — no accident.'

sentences.en: Zero had left a message burned into the wall near the underpass: a single line of code that looked like noise.
sentences.cn: 零点在地下通道附近的墙上烧出了一条信息：一行看起来像噪音的代码。

sentences.en: I ran the filter Grey Crow taught me.
sentences.cn: 我运用灰鸦教我的滤镜。

sentences.en: The *true* text surfaced — a time, a place, and my own badge number.
My hands went cold.
sentences.cn: 我的手冰冷了。

depend:1.en: The bridge checkpoint had two guards and one camera. Whether we could cross before the shift change would *depend* on how fast Ali could loop the feed. She had her device out already, fingers moving without looking down. Grey Crow counted seconds under his breath. Twelve. Eleven.
depend:1.cnHint: 我们能否在换班前通过桥梁检查站，完全____阿里能多快让摄像头的画面循环。
depend:1.hook: At zero, the new guard would walk straight into us.
depend:1.line: 'Everything will *depend* on the next thirty seconds, so move.'

sentences.en: The bridge checkpoint had two guards and one camera.
sentences.cn: 桥检查站有两名卫兵和一台摄像头。

sentences.en: Whether we could cross before the shift change would *depend* on how fast Ali could loop the feed.
She had her device out already, fingers moving without looking down.
sentences.cn: 她已经拿出了设备，手指在快速移动，眼睛都不看一下。

sentences.en: Grey Crow counted seconds under his breath.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在喘息声中数秒。

sentences.en: Twelve.
sentences.cn: 十二。

sentences.en: Eleven.
sentences.cn: 十一。

expensive:1.en: A long black car sat parked outside the signal tower — clean, silent, out of place on a street full of rust and puddles. 'That model is *expensive*,' Ali said quietly. 'City patrol does not drive those.' Grey Crow photographed the plate without slowing his stride. Someone with real money was watching this tower.
expensive:1.cnHint: 信号塔外停着一辆____的黑色轿车，绝不是普通巡逻队能用的。
expensive:1.hook: The plate came back registered to a name that should be dead.
expensive:1.line: 'Something that *expensive* parked here means this tower matters.'

sentences.en: A long black car sat parked outside the signal tower — clean, silent, out of place on a street full of rust and puddles.
sentences.cn: 一辆黑色长车停在信号塔外——干净、安静，在一条满是铁锈和水坑的街道上显得格格不入。

sentences.en: 'That model is *expensive*,' Ali said quietly.
'City patrol does not drive those.'
sentences.cn: 城市巡逻队不开这种车。

sentences.en: Grey Crow photographed the plate without slowing his stride.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在不放慢脚步的情况下拍下了车牌。

sentences.en: Someone with real money was watching this tower.
sentences.cn: 有真正的金钱的人在看守这座塔。

conduct:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside Gate 7. Grey Crow stood under a broken light, watching me cross the wet stones. 'Your *conduct* tonight will decide if you live,' he said, his eyes reading every small move I made. I stopped. The signal was already changing.
conduct:1.cnHint: 在7号门外，引路人观察着我的____，一个错误就可能致命。
conduct:1.hook: The light died, and something moved behind the gate.
conduct:1.line: 'Your *conduct* tonight will decide if you live.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside Gate 7.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着七号门外的街道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow stood under a broken light, watching me cross the wet stones.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦站在一盏坏了的灯下，看我踏过湿漉漉的石板。

sentences.en: 'Your *conduct* tonight will decide if you live,' he said, his eyes reading every small move I made.
I stopped.
sentences.cn: 我停了下来。

sentences.en: The signal was already changing.
sentences.cn: 信号灯已经开始变了。

reveal:1.en: Zero had painted new graffiti on the overpass wall. It looked like noise, but Ali pressed a small scanner to the surface. The pattern began to *reveal* a map — service tunnels, guard posts, the back door into the broadcast tower. I memorized every line fast.
reveal:1.cnHint: 阿栗用扫描仪让涂鸦____了一张隐秘的地图。
reveal:1.hook: One tunnel on the map led somewhere the others did not.
reveal:1.line: 'The wall will *reveal* everything — if you know how to ask.'

sentences.en: Zero had painted new graffiti on the overpass wall.
sentences.cn: 零点在高架桥的墙上画了新的涂鸦。

sentences.en: It looked like noise, but Ali pressed a small scanner to the surface.
sentences.cn: 看起来乱七八糟，但阿栗把一个小扫描仪贴在表面。

sentences.en: The pattern began to *reveal* a map — service tunnels, guard posts, the back door into the broadcast tower.
I memorized every line fast.
sentences.cn: 我快速记住了每一条线。

powerful:1.en: The broadcast tower hummed at the end of Dock Street, its signal *powerful* enough to reach every receiver in Harbor City. Grey Crow said whoever held that tower held the city's voice. Standing this close, I felt the air press against my chest like a second heartbeat.
powerful:1.cnHint: 广播塔的信号____到足以控制整座城市的声音。
powerful:1.hook: A door on the tower's base swung open without a sound.
powerful:1.line: 'That signal is *powerful* enough to rewrite what people believe.'

sentences.en: The broadcast tower hummed at the end of Dock Street, its signal *powerful* enough to reach every receiver in Harbor City.
Grey Crow said whoever held that tower held the city's voice.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说谁拿住了那座塔，谁就拿住了城市的声音。

sentences.en: Standing this close, I felt the air press against my chest like a second heartbeat.
sentences.cn: 站得这么近，我感觉空气贴着我的胸口，像第二颗心脏在跳动。

push:1.en: Ali sent a short message: 'Zero is making a *push* on the east grid — tonight, not tomorrow.' I read it twice under the shelter of a neon sign dripping red light. The east grid meant the relay stations. If Zero took those, our frequency would go silent for good.
push:1.cnHint: 零点正在对东区电网发动一次____，我们的频率危在旦夕。
push:1.hook: My earpiece crackled once, then went completely dead.
push:1.line: 'Zero is making a *push* — we have maybe one hour.'

sentences.en: Ali sent a short message: 'Zero is making a *push* on the east grid — tonight, not tomorrow.'
I read it twice under the shelter of a neon sign dripping red light.
sentences.cn: 我在滴着红光的霓虹灯下读了两遍。

sentences.en: The east grid meant the relay stations.
sentences.cn: 东区网格意味着中继站。

sentences.en: If Zero took those, our frequency would go silent for good.
sentences.cn: 如果零点占领了那些，我们的频率就会永远消失。

wonder:1.en: The old market square was empty except for a child's paper lantern caught on a wire, spinning slowly in the wet wind. I stopped and felt a brief *wonder* — how anything gentle still survived here. Then I saw the chalk mark on the ground. Grey Crow had been here.
wonder:1.cnHint: 在空旷的市场广场，我短暂地感到一种____，随后发现了引路人留下的暗号。
wonder:1.hook: The chalk mark was still fresh, no more than ten minutes old.
wonder:1.line: 'Even in this city, *wonder* can survive — look for it.'

sentences.en: The old market square was empty except for a child's paper lantern caught on a wire, spinning slowly in the wet wind.
sentences.cn: 旧市场广场空荡荡的，只有一只孩子的纸灯笼卡在电线上，在湿润的风中慢慢转动。

sentences.en: I stopped and felt a brief *wonder* — how anything gentle still survived here.
Then I saw the chalk mark on the ground.
sentences.cn: 然后我看到了地上的粉笔标记。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had been here.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦来过这里。

design:1.en: The jammer in my coat pocket was small, barely heavier than a coin. Ali had spent three nights to *design* it: a device that could cut Zero's signal for exactly four seconds. Four seconds. That was all the window I would get at the tower gate.
design:1.cnHint: 阿栗花了三个夜晚来____这个干扰器，它只能为我们争取四秒钟。
design:1.hook: Four seconds felt very short now that I was standing there.
design:1.line: 'I *design* it for four seconds — do not waste a single one.'

sentences.en: The jammer in my coat pocket was small, barely heavier than a coin.
sentences.cn: 我外套口袋里的干扰器很小，几乎跟硬币一样重。

sentences.en: Ali had spent three nights to *design* it: a device that could cut Zero's signal for exactly four seconds.
Four seconds.
sentences.cn: 四秒钟。

sentences.en: That was all the window I would get at the tower gate.
sentences.cn: 那就是我在塔楼大门处能得到的全部机会。

exercise:1.en: Every morning, Zero's crew would *exercise* on the rooftop of the old customs house — a routine as fixed as a clock. Grey Crow had timed it for weeks. That predictable window, six minutes long, was the only moment the street-level camera below them went unwatched.
exercise:1.cnHint: 零点的手下每天在屋顶____，这个固定规律给了我们唯一的机会。
exercise:1.hook: Tomorrow morning the window would open for the last time.
exercise:1.line: 'They *exercise* at dawn — six minutes, and the camera blinks.'

sentences.en: Every morning, Zero's crew would *exercise* on the rooftop of the old customs house — a routine as fixed as a clock.
Grey Crow had timed it for weeks.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦已经计时了好几周。

sentences.en: That predictable window, six minutes long, was the only moment the street-level camera below them went unwatched.
sentences.cn: 那个可预测的窗口，六分钟长，是下面街道摄像头唯一不监视的时刻。

space:1.en: The alley between the two warehouses was tight, barely enough *space* for one person to pass sideways. Grey Crow had chosen it for that reason: no one could follow without being seen. I pressed my back to the cold wall and listened to the city breathe around me.
space:1.cnHint: 两座仓库之间狭窄的____是引路人特意选择的秘密通道。
space:1.hook: Footsteps stopped at the alley entrance, then started again.
space:1.line: 'This *space* is tight enough — one follower, and we know it.'

sentences.en: The alley between the two warehouses was tight, barely enough *space* for one person to pass sideways.
Grey Crow had chosen it for that reason: no one could follow without being seen.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦选了这个地方是有原因的：没人能跟踪而不被看到。

sentences.en: I pressed my back to the cold wall and listened to the city breathe around me.
sentences.cn: 我把背贴在冷墙上，听着城市在我周围呼吸。

explain:1.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a narrow alley off Neon Street. Rain hammered the walls. 'You have thirty seconds,' he said. I tried to *explain* the coded signal I had heard on the east bridge, but the words felt thin against the roar of the city. He did not blink.
explain:1.cnHint: 我试图向引路人____昨晚在东桥截获的暗号，但时间紧迫。
explain:1.hook: He checked his watch and turned away before I finished.
explain:1.line: '*Explain* the signal — every detail, right now.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a narrow alley off Neon Street.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉进霓虹街的一条狭窄巷子里。

sentences.en: Rain hammered the walls.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着墙壁。

sentences.en: 'You have thirty seconds,' he said.
sentences.cn: "你有三十秒，"他说。

sentences.en: I tried to *explain* the coded signal I had heard on the east bridge, but the words felt thin against the roar of the city.
He did not blink.
sentences.cn: 他没有眨眼。

examine:1.en: Ali crouched beside the storm drain under the overpass. Water rushed past her boots. She pulled out a small light and began to *examine* the scratched symbols on the concrete wall — each mark deliberate, each gap a letter in a code only we were trained to read.
examine:1.cnHint: 阿里在高架桥下仔细____墙上刻画的神秘符号。
examine:1.hook: The last symbol was still wet.
examine:1.line: '*Examine* it closely — one wrong reading ends us.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside the storm drain under the overpass.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在高架桥下的雨水沟旁。

sentences.en: Water rushed past her boots.
sentences.cn: 水从她的靴子边冲过。

sentences.en: She pulled out a small light and began to *examine* the scratched symbols on the concrete wall — each mark deliberate, each gap a letter in a code only we were trained to read.

influence:1.en: Zero's broadcast had been running for six hours. Standing at the corner of Cold Harbor Road, I watched people slow down, tilt their heads, and change direction without knowing why. A single hidden frequency could *influence* an entire crowd. That kind of power made my hands cold.
influence:1.cnHint: 零点播放的神秘频率开始____街头人群的行动方向。
influence:1.hook: Then the frequency shifted — and everyone stopped at once.
influence:1.line: 'One signal can *influence* a thousand people without a word.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast had been running for six hours.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播已经运行了六个小时。

sentences.en: Standing at the corner of Cold Harbor Road, I watched people slow down, tilt their heads, and change direction without knowing why.
sentences.cn: 站在寒冷港湾路的角落，我看着人们减速、抬头、改变方向，却不知道为什么。

sentences.en: A single hidden frequency could *influence* an entire crowd.
That kind of power made my hands cold.
sentences.cn: 那种力量让我的手冰冷。

argue:1.en: Grey Crow said we should move north. I said east. We stood in the middle of Rain Market, voices low but sharp, neither willing to give ground. People pushed past us with umbrellas and bags. To *argue* in the open was a risk, but silence felt worse right now.
argue:1.cnHint: 我和引路人在雨市场中心就撤退方向____，争执不下。
argue:1.hook: Ali's urgent message cut our argument dead.
argue:1.line: 'Don't *argue* here — Zero's people are watching the market.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow said we should move north.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说我们应该向北走。

sentences.en: I said east.
sentences.cn: 我说向东。

sentences.en: We stood in the middle of Rain Market, voices low but sharp, neither willing to give ground.
sentences.cn: 我们站在雨市的中间，声音低沉但尖锐，都不愿退让。

sentences.en: People pushed past us with umbrellas and bags.
sentences.cn: 人们拿着伞和包从我们身边挤过。

sentences.en: To *argue* in the open was a risk, but silence felt worse right now.

pass:1.en: I needed to reach the relay post on the far side of Bridge Nine. Two of Zero's watchers stood at the gate, scanning faces. I pulled my collar up and walked at a steady pace. The moment I *passed* them without a word, my heart slowed by one beat.
pass:1.cnHint: 我试图悄悄____零点的两名监视者，独自抵达九号桥的信号站。
pass:1.hook: One of them turned and called out a single word.
pass:1.line: 'If you *pass* the gate without a signal, they know you're clean.'

sentences.en: I needed to reach the relay post on the far side of Bridge Nine.
sentences.cn: 我得穿过九号桥那边去到中继站。

sentences.en: Two of Zero's watchers stood at the gate, scanning faces.
sentences.cn: 零点的两个监视者站在门口，扫描着每张脸。

sentences.en: I pulled my collar up and walked at a steady pace.
sentences.cn: 我竖起衣领，以稳定的步伐走过去。

sentences.en: The moment I *passed* them without a word, my heart slowed by one beat.

serious:1.en: Ali met me outside the transit hub, her face set like stone. She handed me a folded printout without a word. The data showed Zero's network had grown to forty nodes overnight. This was no longer a small breach — the situation was *serious*, and every hour we waited made it worse.
serious:1.cnHint: 阿里递给我一份数据报告，局势已经变得非常____。
serious:1.hook: Grey Crow's name appeared at the bottom of the list.
serious:1.line: 'This is *serious* — forty nodes live and we missed every one.'

sentences.en: Ali met me outside the transit hub, her face set like stone.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在运输中心外面等我，脸色铁青。

sentences.en: She handed me a folded printout without a word.
sentences.cn: 她递给我一张折叠的打印纸，一言不发。

sentences.en: The data showed Zero's network had grown to forty nodes overnight.
sentences.cn: 数据显示零点的网络在一夜之间扩展到了四十个节点。

sentences.en: This was no longer a small breach — the situation was *serious*, and every hour we waited made it worse.

despite:1.en: The rain had not stopped for three days. *Despite* the flooded gutters and the cracked screens on every corner, Zero's coded graffiti kept spreading — new marks on bus shelters, bridge rails, and market walls. The city was being rewritten, one illegal symbol at a time, right in front of us.
despite:1.cnHint: ____连日暴雨的阻碍，零点的密语涂鸦仍在全城蔓延。
despite:1.hook: By dawn, the central tower wall carried the longest message yet.
despite:1.line: '*Despite* the flood, the marks are still spreading — how?'

sentences.en: The rain had not stopped for three days.
sentences.cn: 雨已经下了三天没停。

sentences.en: *Despite* the flooded gutters and the cracked screens on every corner, Zero's coded graffiti kept spreading — new marks on bus shelters, bridge rails, and market walls.
The city was being rewritten, one illegal symbol at a time, right in front of us.
sentences.cn: 这座城市正在被一点一点地改写，每一个非法的符号都出现在我们眼前。

express:1.en: Grey Crow rarely showed feeling. So when he grabbed my arm near the old signal tower and held my gaze for a full second, I paid attention. His eyes seemed to *express* something he could not say aloud — a warning deeper than words, meant only for me.
express:1.cnHint: 引路人用眼神向我____某种无法开口说出的紧急警告。
express:1.hook: He released my arm and walked away into the rain.
express:1.line: 'I can't say it out loud — my eyes will *express* it for me.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow rarely showed feeling.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦很少表露感情。

sentences.en: So when he grabbed my arm near the old signal tower and held my gaze for a full second, I paid attention.
sentences.cn: 所以当他在老信号塔附近抓住我的手臂，并盯着我看了整整一秒钟时，我注意到了。

sentences.en: His eyes seemed to *express* something he could not say aloud — a warning deeper than words, meant only for me.

career:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Gate Seven. Grey Crow pulled me close and whispered: my whole *career* started on this block, one stolen signal at a time. Now Zero owns every corner. I looked at the dark windows above us and felt something cold move through my chest.
career:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在街角告诉我，他整个____都从这里开始，但现在这片地盘已经落入零点之手。
career:1.hook: A red light blinked once, then the street went silent.
career:1.line: 'My *career* began here — and it may end here too.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Gate Seven.
sentences.cn: 雨砸打着七号门外那条裂开的街道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me close and whispered: my whole *career* started on this block, one stolen signal at a time.
Now Zero owns every corner.
sentences.cn: 现在零点拥有了每个角落。

sentences.en: I looked at the dark windows above us and felt something cold move through my chest.
sentences.cn: 我看着我们上方那些黑漆漆的窗户，感到一阵寒意窜过我的胸膛。

medium:1.en: The signal came through a cracked wall screen, the only working *medium* left on Dock Street after the grid purge. Ali pressed her ear to the static and nodded slowly. Something was buried inside the noise — a pattern, a name, maybe a warning. We had thirty seconds before the feed died.
medium:1.cnHint: 阿栗在一块破损屏幕上发现，这是停电后唯一还能传递信号的____，里面藏着某种规律。
medium:1.hook: The screen flashed white, and the name vanished.
medium:1.line: 'This *medium* is old, but the message inside is new.'

sentences.en: The signal came through a cracked wall screen, the only working *medium* left on Dock Street after the grid purge.
Ali pressed her ear to the static and nodded slowly.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把耳朵贴在静电声上，缓缓点了点头。

sentences.en: Something was buried inside the noise — a pattern, a name, maybe a warning.
sentences.cn: 有什么东西埋在噪声里——一种模式，一个名字，也许是一个警告。

sentences.en: We had thirty seconds before the feed died.
sentences.cn: 信号在三十秒后就会中断。

office:1.en: The sign above the door read HARBOUR RECORDS, but everyone on the street knew it was Zero's front *office*. I stood across the wet road, collar up, watching a shadow move behind frosted glass. Ali touched my arm. 'One guard,' she said quietly. 'Maybe two.' The rain kept falling.
office:1.cnHint: 零点在这栋楼里设有秘密____，我和阿栗在雨中监视着里面的动静。
office:1.hook: The frosted glass went dark, and footsteps hit the stairs.
office:1.line: 'That *office* holds every secret Zero wants buried.'

sentences.en: The sign above the door read HARBOUR RECORDS, but everyone on the street knew it was Zero's front *office*.
I stood across the wet road, collar up, watching a shadow move behind frosted glass.
sentences.cn: 我站在湿漉漉的对面街上，竖起衣领，看着一个影子在毛玻璃后面移动。

sentences.en: Ali touched my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗碰了碰我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'One guard,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "只有一个守卫，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Maybe two.'
sentences.cn: "也许两个。"

sentences.en: The rain kept falling.
sentences.cn: 雨还在下。

culture:1.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall — symbols drawn from the old port *culture* that only dock workers once understood. Grey Crow ran a finger along the shapes and smiled without warmth. 'Zero learned this language too,' he said. I copied the pattern into my notebook before the rain washed it away.
culture:1.cnHint: 地下通道的涂鸦来自古老的港口____，灰鸦说零点也已经掌握了这套暗语。
culture:1.hook: One symbol had been crossed out — crossed out today.
culture:1.line: 'This *culture* gave us the code; now it can betray us.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall — symbols drawn from the old port *culture* that only dock workers once understood.
Grey Crow ran a finger along the shapes and smiled without warmth.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用手指沿着这些形状滑过，冷冷地笑了。

sentences.en: 'Zero learned this language too,' he said.
sentences.cn: "零点也学会了这种语言，"他说。

sentences.en: I copied the pattern into my notebook before the rain washed it away.
sentences.cn: 我把这个图案抄进了笔记本，在雨冲走它之前。

college:1.en: The abandoned *college* at the edge of the waterfront district had been dark for twenty years, but tonight three windows glowed amber. Grey Crow said Zero once studied signals here, before the shutdown. I stepped through the gate and heard something move inside — heavy, deliberate, not afraid of us at all.
college:1.cnHint: 废弃的____今晚亮着灯，灰鸦说零点曾在这里学习信号技术。
college:1.hook: A door opened from the inside before I could knock.
college:1.line: 'This *college* died, but the experiments never stopped.'

sentences.en: The abandoned *college* at the edge of the waterfront district had been dark for twenty years, but tonight three windows glowed amber.
Grey Crow said Zero once studied signals here, before the shutdown.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说零点曾经在这里研究信号，在关闭之前。

sentences.en: I stepped through the gate and heard something move inside — heavy, deliberate, not afraid of us at all.
sentences.cn: 我走过门，听到里面有东西在移动——沉重、刻意、一点都不害怕我们。

value:1.en: Ali held up the small data chip and turned it slowly in the neon light. 'You have no idea of its *value*,' she said, and her voice was tight. Zero had crossed half the city for this chip. Whatever was on it could rewrite the power map of Harbor City in a single night.
value:1.cnHint: 阿栗捡到一枚芯片，告诉我它的____远超我的想象，零点正在全城追寻它。
value:1.hook: A black vehicle turned the corner, moving fast and quiet.
value:1.line: 'The *value* of this chip is why people are already dead.'

sentences.en: Ali held up the small data chip and turned it slowly in the neon light.
sentences.cn: 阿栗举起那枚小数据芯片，在霓虹灯下缓缓转动。

sentences.en: 'You have no idea of its *value*,' she said, and her voice was tight.
Zero had crossed half the city for this chip.
sentences.cn: 零点已经穿过了半个城市来夺取这块芯片。

sentences.en: Whatever was on it could rewrite the power map of Harbor City in a single night.
sentences.cn: 不管里面是什么，都可以在一夜之间改写港湾城的权力格局。

connection:1.en: Grey Crow sketched a quick map on the wet pavement with a piece of chalk. Every dot was a relay tower; every line was a *connection* Zero controlled. I counted nine lines. Ali counted ten. We looked at each other. One relay was off the map — hidden, private, ours if we moved now.
connection:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在地面画出信号网络图，每条线代表一个零点掌控的____，但我们发现了一条他不知道的。
connection:1.hook: The chalk line washed away before either of us memorised it.
connection:1.line: 'Break one *connection* and the whole network goes blind.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow sketched a quick map on the wet pavement with a piece of chalk.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用粉笔在湿漉漉的人行道上快速画了一张地图。

sentences.en: Every dot was a relay tower; every line was a *connection* Zero controlled.
I counted nine lines.
sentences.cn: 我数了九条线。

sentences.en: Ali counted ten.
sentences.cn: 阿栗数了十条。

sentences.en: We looked at each other.
sentences.cn: 我们互相看了看。

sentences.en: One relay was off the map — hidden, private, ours if we moved now.
sentences.cn: 有一个中继站不在地图上——隐藏的、私人的，如果我们现在行动的话，就是我们的。

story:1.en: The old news kiosk at the north end of Canal Street still ran paper sheets every morning. Today's top *story* was blank — white space where the headline should be. Ali said that only happened once before, the night the city's main broadcast tower burned. Someone was killing the news before it could speak.
story:1.cnHint: 街角报亭今天的头条____是一片空白，阿栗说上次这样发生时，广播塔被烧毁了。
story:1.hook: My own face appeared on the sheet below the blank space.
story:1.line: 'Every *story* they erase is a door they are trying to lock.'

sentences.en: The old news kiosk at the north end of Canal Street still ran paper sheets every morning.
sentences.cn: 运河街北端那家老报刊亭每天早上还在印刷纸张。

sentences.en: Today's top *story* was blank — white space where the headline should be.
Ali said that only happened once before, the night the city's main broadcast tower burned.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说这只发生过一次，就是城市主广播塔烧毁的那晚。

sentences.en: Someone was killing the news before it could speak.
sentences.cn: 有人在杀死新闻，在它能开口说话之前。

real:1.en: The rain hit my coat like static noise. Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway and pointed at a shadow moving fast across the wet street. 'That signal you picked up,' he said quietly, 'it's *real*. Zero is already here.' The neon signs flickered. Somewhere close, a door slammed.
real:1.cnHint: 引路人警告我，那个神秘信号是____的，对手已经抵达。
real:1.hook: The shadow stopped, turned, and looked straight at me.
real:1.line: 'That signal is *real* — Zero does not bluff.'

sentences.en: The rain hit my coat like static noise.
sentences.cn: 雨打在我的外套上，像是静电噪音。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway and pointed at a shadow moving fast across the wet street.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉进门廊，指着一个黑影在湿漉漉的街道上快速移动。

sentences.en: 'That signal you picked up,' he said quietly, 'it's *real*.
Zero is already here.'
sentences.cn: 零点已经来了。

sentences.en: The neon signs flickered.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯闪烁。

sentences.en: Somewhere close, a door slammed.
sentences.cn: 某个地方传来摔门的声音。

talk:1.en: Ali grabbed my arm near the old signal tower at the edge of the market. Vendors were packing up fast. 'There's *talk* on the street,' she said, eyes moving left and right, 'that Zero has bought someone inside our unit.' The rain thickened. No one looked at us. That was the problem.
talk:1.cnHint: 阿里在市场边悄悄告诉我，街头有关于叛徒的____。
talk:1.hook: She dropped my arm and walked away without another word.
talk:1.line: 'There is *talk* that someone close to us is already turned.'

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm near the old signal tower at the edge of the market.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在市场边缘的老信号塔附近抓住我的手臂。

sentences.en: Vendors were packing up fast.
sentences.cn: 小贩们收摊收得飞快。

sentences.en: 'There's *talk* on the street,' she said, eyes moving left and right, 'that Zero has bought someone inside our unit.'
The rain thickened.
sentences.cn: 雨下得更大了。

sentences.en: No one looked at us.
sentences.cn: 没有人看我们。

sentences.en: That was the problem.
sentences.cn: 那就是问题所在。

energy:1.en: Zero's broadcast cut through every channel at once. Grey Crow pressed his back against the cold wall of the underpass and closed his eyes. 'Feel that?' he said. 'That transmission carries *energy* that no legal grid can produce.' Above us, the bridge lights died. The whole block went dark in one breath.
energy:1.cnHint: 引路人感知到零点广播中蕴含着非法来源的____。
energy:1.hook: In the sudden dark, something started moving toward us.
energy:1.line: 'That signal carries *energy* no legal grid could ever produce.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast cut through every channel at once.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播同时切入了每个频道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed his back against the cold wall of the underpass and closed his eyes.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把后背贴在地下通道冰冷的墙壁上，闭上眼睛。

sentences.en: 'Feel that?' he said.
sentences.cn: 他说，"感觉到了吗？"

sentences.en: 'That transmission carries *energy* that no legal grid can produce.'
Above us, the bridge lights died.
sentences.cn: 我们上方的桥梁灯灭了。

sentences.en: The whole block went dark in one breath.
sentences.cn: 整个街区在一瞬间陷入黑暗。

plan:1.en: I found the chalk mark on the wall behind the night market — Grey Crow's signal for a meeting. He was already there, collar up against the rain. 'Zero has a *plan*,' he said, spreading a damp sheet of coded paper on a crate between us. 'It starts tonight. Right here on this street.'
plan:1.cnHint: 引路人展示证据，零点已有一个针对今晚的____。
plan:1.hook: His finger landed on a circled time: 23:00 — ten minutes from now.
plan:1.line: 'Zero has a *plan*, and this street is where it begins.'

sentences.en: I found the chalk mark on the wall behind the night market — Grey Crow's signal for a meeting.
sentences.cn: 我在夜市后面的墙上找到了粉笔标记——灰鸦约见面的暗号。

sentences.en: He was already there, collar up against the rain.
sentences.cn: 他已经在那儿了，衣领竖起来挡雨。

sentences.en: 'Zero has a *plan*,' he said, spreading a damp sheet of coded paper on a crate between us.
'It starts tonight.
sentences.cn: 今晚就开始。

sentences.en: Right here on this street.'
sentences.cn: 就在这条街上。

bear:1.en: The package was small but Grey Crow would not touch it. He looked at me from across the rain-slicked alley. 'You're the only one who can *bear* the signal inside that case,' he said. 'It reads your frequency and no one else's.' I picked it up. It hummed against my palm like a living thing.
bear:1.cnHint: 引路人说只有我能____箱子里那个特殊信号的重量。
bear:1.hook: The hum grew louder the moment I stepped toward the street.
bear:1.line: 'Only you can *bear* the signal locked inside that case.'

sentences.en: The package was small but Grey Crow would not touch it.
sentences.cn: 包裹很小，但灰鸦不肯碰它。

sentences.en: He looked at me from across the rain-slicked alley.
sentences.cn: 他从雨水打湿的小巷那一端看着我。

sentences.en: 'You're the only one who can *bear* the signal inside that case,' he said.
'It reads your frequency and no one else's.'
sentences.cn: 它读取你的频率，其他人的读不了。

sentences.en: I picked it up.
sentences.cn: 我拿起了它。

sentences.en: It hummed against my palm like a living thing.
sentences.cn: 它在我的掌心嗡嗡作响，像是活着的东西。

organization:1.en: Ali stopped under a dead streetlight and showed me a symbol sprayed on the shutter of a closed shop. It was small and easy to miss. 'That mark belongs to Zero's *organization*,' she said, voice flat. 'I counted nine of them between here and the bridge.' Nine marks. Nine points on a map. A shape was forming.
organization:1.cnHint: 阿里发现了零点____留下的标记，遍布整条街道。
organization:1.hook: The ninth mark was still wet.
organization:1.line: 'Every mark on this street belongs to Zero's *organization*.'

sentences.en: Ali stopped under a dead streetlight and showed me a symbol sprayed on the shutter of a closed shop.
sentences.cn: 阿栗停在一盏死掉的路灯下，给我看一个喷在某间关闭的店铺卷帘门上的符号。

sentences.en: It was small and easy to miss.
sentences.cn: 那很小，容易被忽略。

sentences.en: 'That mark belongs to Zero's *organization*,' she said, voice flat.
'I counted nine of them between here and the bridge.'
sentences.cn: 我从这儿到桥那边数了九个标记。

sentences.en: Nine marks.
sentences.cn: 九个标记。

sentences.en: Nine points on a map.
sentences.cn: 地图上的九个点。

sentences.en: A shape was forming.
sentences.cn: 一个图形正在成形。

opportunity:1.en: The crowd pouring out of the transit hub gave us cover. Grey Crow moved close and spoke fast. 'This is our *opportunity* — Zero's courier is thirty seconds ahead of us, carrying the master key.' I pushed forward through wet shoulders and noise. The signal in my head flared bright. Thirty seconds. Counting down.
opportunity:1.cnHint: 引路人提示我，人群制造了一个追上零点信使的____。
opportunity:1.hook: I spotted the courier — but he had already spotted me.
opportunity:1.line: 'This *opportunity* will not come again — move now.'

sentences.en: The crowd pouring out of the transit hub gave us cover.
sentences.cn: 从转运枢纽涌出的人群给了我们掩护。

sentences.en: Grey Crow moved close and spoke fast.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦靠近我，快速说话。

sentences.en: 'This is our *opportunity* — Zero's courier is thirty seconds ahead of us, carrying the master key.'
I pushed forward through wet shoulders and noise.
sentences.cn: 我穿过湿漉漉的肩膀和噪音往前推进。

sentences.en: The signal in my head flared bright.
sentences.cn: 我脑子里的信号闪得很亮。

sentences.en: Thirty seconds.
sentences.cn: 三十秒。

sentences.en: Counting down.
sentences.cn: 倒计时。

professor:1.en: The old broadcast university stood hollow at the end of the street. Ali pointed up at a lit window on the fourth floor. 'There's a *professor* who cracked Zero's first cipher,' she said quietly. 'Zero knows it too.' A figure passed the window. The light went out. The figure did not come back to the glass.
professor:1.cnHint: 阿里说有一位____曾破解过零点的密码，而对手也知道此事。
professor:1.hook: The door to the building swung open before either of us touched it.
professor:1.line: 'That *professor* broke Zero's first cipher — and paid for it.'

sentences.en: The old broadcast university stood hollow at the end of the street.
sentences.cn: 那栋老广播大学在街尾空荡荡地矗立。

sentences.en: Ali pointed up at a lit window on the fourth floor.
sentences.cn: 阿栗指向四楼一扇亮着的窗户。

sentences.en: 'There's a *professor* who cracked Zero's first cipher,' she said quietly.
'Zero knows it too.'
sentences.cn: 零点也知道。

sentences.en: A figure passed the window.
sentences.cn: 一个身影从窗户前经过。

sentences.en: The light went out.
sentences.cn: 灯灭了。

sentences.en: The figure did not come back to the glass.
sentences.cn: 那个身影没有回到玻璃窗前。

sign:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside Zero's last known drop point. I scanned every surface — cracked walls, dead screens, rusted pipes. Then I saw it: a chalk mark on the corner post, a small arrow. That *sign* was not random. Someone had been here minutes ago, leaving a trail only I could read.
sign:1.cnHint: 我在街角发现了一个____，意识到有人刚刚离开。
sign:1.line: 'That *sign* means someone is watching us right now,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside Zero's last known drop point.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着零点最后一个投递点外的街道。

sentences.en: I scanned every surface — cracked walls, dead screens, rusted pipes.
sentences.cn: 我扫描每个表面——裂开的墙，死掉的屏幕，生锈的管子。

sentences.en: Then I saw it: a chalk mark on the corner post, a small arrow.
sentences.cn: 然后我看到了：角柱子上的粉笔标记，一个小箭头。

sentences.en: That *sign* was not random.
Someone had been here minutes ago, leaving a trail only I could read.
sentences.cn: 几分钟前有人在这儿，留下只有我能读的踪迹。

feeling:1.en: The alley smelled of old oil and burnt wire. I stood still, listening to the city hum. Something was wrong — I could not name it, but the *feeling* pressed against my ribs like a cold hand. Ali touched my shoulder. I did not move. The street was too quiet.
feeling:1.cnHint: 一种强烈的____让我停下脚步，感觉有危险靠近。
feeling:1.hook: Then every streetlight went dark at once.
feeling:1.line: 'Trust that *feeling*,' Grey Crow said, 'it has saved me twice.'

sentences.en: The alley smelled of old oil and burnt wire.
sentences.cn: 小巷闻起来像旧油和烧焦的电线。

sentences.en: I stood still, listening to the city hum.
sentences.cn: 我静静地站着，听着城市的嗡嗡声。

sentences.en: Something was wrong — I could not name it, but the *feeling* pressed against my ribs like a cold hand.
Ali touched my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗摸了摸我的肩膀。

sentences.en: I did not move.
sentences.cn: 我没有动。

sentences.en: The street was too quiet.
sentences.cn: 街道太安静了。

professional:1.en: The trap was clean — no loose ends, no wasted steps. Whoever set it knew exactly where I would walk. Ali crouched by the trigger wire and let out a slow breath. 'This is *professional* work,' she said. I looked down the empty street. Zero did not make mistakes like amateurs.
professional:1.cnHint: 阿栗检查了陷阱，判断出这是____人士的手笔。
professional:1.hook: Which meant Zero had been here before us.
professional:1.line: 'Only a *professional* could have set this without a single trace.'

sentences.en: The trap was clean — no loose ends, no wasted steps.
sentences.cn: 陷阱很干净——没有余端，没有浪费的步骤。

sentences.en: Whoever set it knew exactly where I would walk.
sentences.cn: 无论是谁设下的陷阱，都确切地知道我会走哪条路。

sentences.en: Ali crouched by the trigger wire and let out a slow breath.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在引信线旁，缓缓呼出一口气。

sentences.en: 'This is *professional* work,' she said.
I looked down the empty street.
sentences.cn: 我往空荡荡的街道下面看。

sentences.en: Zero did not make mistakes like amateurs.
sentences.cn: 零点不会像业余人那样犯错。

behind:1.en: I ran hard, boots slapping wet stone. The signal I was chasing pulsed two blocks north. Grey Crow's voice cut through my earpiece: slow down. I did not slow down. Then I heard footsteps *behind* me — steady, unhurried — as if whoever followed knew exactly where I was going.
behind:1.cnHint: 我在追踪信号时，发现有人紧跟在我____。
behind:1.hook: The footsteps stopped the moment I stopped.
behind:1.line: 'Do not look *behind* you,' Grey Crow said, 'keep walking.'

sentences.en: I ran hard, boots slapping wet stone.
sentences.cn: 我用力跑，靴子拍打着湿石头。

sentences.en: The signal I was chasing pulsed two blocks north.
sentences.cn: 我追的信号向北两个街区跳动。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice cut through my earpiece: slow down.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的声音穿过我的耳机：慢下来。

sentences.en: I did not slow down.
sentences.cn: 我没有慢下来。

sentences.en: Then I heard footsteps *behind* me — steady, unhurried — as if whoever followed knew exactly where I was going.

government:1.en: The old broadcast tower stood at the edge of the market square, wrapped in warning tape. A faded board read: PROPERTY OF CITY AUTHORITY. Ali pointed at fresh bolts on the base panel. 'The *government* sealed this three days ago,' she said. Yet the antenna was still sending a live signal.
government:1.cnHint: 这座被____封锁的广播塔，竟然还在发出信号。
government:1.line: 'The *government* does not seal a tower unless it hides something.'

sentences.en: The old broadcast tower stood at the edge of the market square, wrapped in warning tape.
sentences.cn: 那座老广播塔矗立在市场广场的边缘，被警示胶带缠成了一团。

sentences.en: A faded board read: PROPERTY OF CITY AUTHORITY.
sentences.cn: 一块褪色的木板上写着：城市管理部门产业。

sentences.en: Ali pointed at fresh bolts on the base panel.
sentences.cn: 阿栗指了指底座面板上崭新的螺栓。

sentences.en: 'The *government* sealed this three days ago,' she said.
Yet the antenna was still sending a live signal.
sentences.cn: 可天线还在发送实时信号。

growth:1.en: Vines had split the pavement along the north wall, green stems forcing through cracked stone. The city called it natural *growth*, but Grey Crow knelt and pulled one vine aside, revealing a thin cable buried underneath. Nature had not done this. Someone had planted the vines to hide a wire.
growth:1.cnHint: 街道上的植物____掩盖了一条秘密电缆。
growth:1.hook: The cable led straight toward the city core.
growth:1.line: 'This *growth* was not an accident,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: Vines had split the pavement along the north wall, green stems forcing through cracked stone.
sentences.cn: 藤蔓沿着北墙裂开了人行道，绿色的茎蔓从破裂的石头里硬生生挤了出来。

sentences.en: The city called it natural *growth*, but Grey Crow knelt and pulled one vine aside, revealing a thin cable buried underneath.
Nature had not done this.

sentences.en: Someone had planted the vines to hide a wire.
sentences.cn: 有人种了这些藤蔓来隐藏一根电线。

negative:1.en: I ran the signal through my decoder. The result came back *negative* — no match, no known source, nothing on record. Ali frowned at the screen. But the signal was real; I could hear it. Zero had built something outside every database we had, something the city's own systems refused to see.
negative:1.cnHint: 解码器给出了____结果，但信号明明真实存在。
negative:1.hook: Invisible signals are the most dangerous kind.
negative:1.line: 'A *negative* result does not mean nothing is there,' Ali said.

sentences.en: I ran the signal through my decoder.
sentences.cn: 我用解码器处理了那个信号。

sentences.en: The result came back *negative* — no match, no known source, nothing on record.
Ali frowned at the screen.
sentences.cn: 阿栗皱着眉看着屏幕。

sentences.en: But the signal was real; I could hear it.
sentences.cn: 但信号是真实的，我能听见。

sentences.en: Zero had built something outside every database we had, something the city's own systems refused to see.
sentences.cn: 零点造了什么东西，它超出了我们所有数据库的范围，连城市自己的系统都拒绝看到它。

potential:1.en: Grey Crow spread a map across a wet crate. He circled three intersections in red. 'Each one is a *potential* relay point,' he said. Zero needed only one of them active to broadcast city-wide. I studied the circles. We had two hours. Choosing the wrong intersection would cost us everything.
potential:1.cnHint: 灰鸦标出了三个____的信号中转点，我们必须选对一个。
potential:1.hook: Zero was already moving toward one of them.
potential:1.line: 'Every *potential* point is a trap waiting to open,' Grey Crow warned.

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a map across a wet crate.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一张地图铺在湿漉漉的板条箱上。

sentences.en: He circled three intersections in red.
sentences.cn: 他用红笔圈了三个交叉路口。

sentences.en: 'Each one is a *potential* relay point,' he said.
Zero needed only one of them active to broadcast city-wide.
sentences.cn: 零点只需要其中一个中继点活跃，就能进行全市广播。

sentences.en: I studied the circles.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那些圆圈。

sentences.en: We had two hours.
sentences.cn: 我们只有两个小时。

sentences.en: Choosing the wrong intersection would cost us everything.

force:1.en: Rain hammered the street. Zero's men circled me near the old signal tower. I had no weapon, no exit. They tried to *force* me toward a black van, boots scraping wet concrete. Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Hold your ground. Two minutes.'
force:1.cnHint: 零点的手下试图用____将我带走，我在信号塔附近陷入包围。
force:1.hook: The van door slid open, and something moved inside.
force:1.line: 'They will *force* you into that van — do not let them.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street.
sentences.cn: 雨猛砸着街道。

sentences.en: Zero's men circled me near the old signal tower.
sentences.cn: 零点的人在老信号塔附近包围了我。

sentences.en: I had no weapon, no exit.
sentences.cn: 我没有武器，没有出口。

sentences.en: They tried to *force* me toward a black van, boots scraping wet concrete.
Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Hold your ground.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的声音在我的耳机里劈啪作响："站住不动。

sentences.en: Two minutes.'

importance:1.en: Ali knelt beside a cracked wall of coded graffiti under the bridge. 'Most people walk past this,' she said quietly. I understood now the *importance* of every painted symbol — each one was a dead-drop address, a breadcrumb left by runners who never came back.
importance:1.cnHint: 阿里在桥下向我解释那些涂鸦的____，每一个符号都藏着秘密地址。
importance:1.hook: One symbol was still wet — painted less than an hour ago.
importance:1.line: 'You must understand the *importance* of what is written here.'

sentences.en: Ali knelt beside a cracked wall of coded graffiti under the bridge.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在桥下满是密码涂鸦的裂口墙边跪了下来。

sentences.en: 'Most people walk past this,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "大多数人走过这里都没注意，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: I understood now the *importance* of every painted symbol — each one was a dead-drop address, a breadcrumb left by runners who never came back.

sell:1.en: The night market buzzed with traders and smoke. Grey Crow pointed to a stall where a man offered blank data chips. 'He does not *sell* those chips,' Grey Crow murmured. 'He collects the faces of everyone who buys them.' I looked again. A lens blinked inside the stall lamp.

sell:1.hook: The man behind the stall met my eyes and smiled.
sell:1.line: 'He does not *sell* anything — he only harvests.'

sentences.en: The night market buzzed with traders and smoke.
sentences.cn: 夜市嗡嗡作响，烟雾缭绕，商人们络绎不绝。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed to a stall where a man offered blank data chips.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向一个摊位，那里一个男人在兜售空白芯片。

sentences.en: 'He does not *sell* those chips,' Grey Crow murmured.
'He collects the faces of everyone who buys them.'
sentences.cn: "他记下了每个买芯片的人的脸。"

sentences.cn: 我又看了一遍。

sentences.en: A lens blinked inside the stall lamp.

replace:1.en: Ali and I crouched behind a steam vent on Market Row. The city's old broadcast towers were going dark one by one. 'Zero plans to *replace* every public signal node with his own,' Ali said, her breath a white cloud in the cold air. No node, no honest voice left.
replace:1.cnHint: 阿里说，零点打算用自己的设备____城市里所有的公共信号节点。
replace:1.hook: The last honest tower flickered, then went completely silent.
replace:1.line: 'If he can *replace* those towers, we lose every clean channel.'

sentences.en: Ali and I crouched behind a steam vent on Market Row.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我蹲在市场路一个蒸汽通风口后面。

sentences.en: The city's old broadcast towers were going dark one by one.
sentences.cn: 城市的老广播塔一个接一个地熄灭了。

sentences.en: 'Zero plans to *replace* every public signal node with his own,' Ali said, her breath a white cloud in the cold air.
No node, no honest voice left.
sentences.cn: 没有节点，就没有诚实的声音了。

approach:1.en: Fog rolled thick along the harbour front. I spotted a figure in grey at the far end of the dock. Grey Crow had told me the best *approach* was along the sea wall — less light, less noise. I moved low and steady, water slapping the stone below my feet.
approach:1.cnHint: 灰鸦建议我沿海堤____目标，那条路灯光最暗、声音最小。
approach:1.hook: Halfway across the wall, a second shadow rose ahead of me.
approach:1.line: 'Your safest *approach* is along the wall — trust me on this.'

sentences.en: Fog rolled thick along the harbour front.
sentences.cn: 浓雾沿着港口前滩卷了过来。

sentences.en: I spotted a figure in grey at the far end of the dock.
sentences.cn: 我在码头远端看到了一个穿着灰色衣服的身影。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me the best *approach* was along the sea wall — less light, less noise.
I moved low and steady, water slapping the stone below my feet.
sentences.cn: 我低身稳步前进，水拍打着我脚下的石头。

engage:1.en: Zero's signal drone swept the alley in slow arcs. Ali grabbed my sleeve. 'Don't *engage* it,' she warned. 'The moment you do, every camera on this block wakes up.' I pressed flat against the cold brick and watched the drone's red light pass an inch from my face.
engage:1.cnHint: 阿里警告我不要____那架无人机，否则整条街的摄像头都会被激活。
engage:1.hook: The drone paused, reversed, and began its sweep again.
engage:1.line: 'Do not *engage* the drone — one wrong move and we are visible.'

sentences.en: Zero's signal drone swept the alley in slow arcs.
sentences.cn: 零点的信号无人机在小巷里缓缓扫过。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'Don't *engage* it,' she warned.
'The moment you do, every camera on this block wakes up.'
sentences.cn: "你一出手，整个街区的摄像头都会启动。"

sentences.en: I pressed flat against the cold brick and watched the drone's red light pass an inch from my face.
sentences.cn: 我紧贴着冷冰冰的砖墙，看着无人机的红灯从我脸前一英寸处扫过。

ensure:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a small silver tag at the checkpoint gate. 'Clip it to your coat,' he said. 'It will *ensure* the scanners read you as maintenance crew.' The gate lights shifted from red to amber. I clipped the tag, pulled my collar up, and stepped through.
ensure:1.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一个银色标签，说它能____扫描仪将我识别为维修人员。
ensure:1.hook: Amber held for three long seconds, then began blinking red.
ensure:1.line: 'Wear it close — it will *ensure* you pass without a flag.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a small silver tag at the checkpoint gate.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在检查站门口递给了我一个小银色标签。

sentences.en: 'Clip it to your coat,' he said.
sentences.cn: "夹在你的外套上，"他说。

sentences.en: 'It will *ensure* the scanners read you as maintenance crew.'
The gate lights shifted from red to amber.
sentences.cn: 门的灯从红色变成了琥珀色。

sentences.en: I clipped the tag, pulled my collar up, and stepped through.
sentences.cn: 我夹上标签，拉起衣领，走了过去。

limit:1.en: We reached the rooftop relay station just before midnight. The encrypted broadcast window was narrow. 'There is a *limit* to how long we can transmit before Zero triangulates us,' Ali said, fingers flying across the keypad. Sixty seconds. We had exactly sixty seconds to send the truth out.
limit:1.cnHint: 阿里说，我们的传输时间有____，超时就会被零点定位。
limit:1.hook: Forty seconds in, heavy boots rang on the stairwell below.
limit:1.line: 'Remember the time *limit* — sixty seconds and then we run.'

sentences.en: We reached the rooftop relay station just before midnight.
sentences.cn: 我们在午夜前到达了屋顶中继站。

sentences.en: The encrypted broadcast window was narrow.
sentences.cn: 加密广播窗口很窄。

sentences.en: 'There is a *limit* to how long we can transmit before Zero triangulates us,' Ali said, fingers flying across the keypad.
Sixty seconds.
sentences.cn: 六十秒。

sentences.en: We had exactly sixty seconds to send the truth out.
sentences.cn: 我们只有整整六十秒来把真相传播出去。

video:1.en: A cracked screen flickered above the noodle stand. Ali grabbed my arm. 'Look,' she said. The *video* feed showed our faces, filmed ten minutes ago, right here on this street. Someone had been watching before we arrived. The timestamp was wrong — or worse, it was right.
video:1.cnHint: 街边的屏幕上出现了一段____，画面里竟然是我们自己。
video:1.hook: Ali whispered, 'That camera has no power source — none at all.'
video:1.line: 'The *video* proves we were being followed before we knew it.'

sentences.en: A cracked screen flickered above the noodle stand.
sentences.cn: 破裂的屏幕在面摊上方闪烁。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'Look,' she said.
sentences.cn: "看，"她说。

sentences.en: The *video* feed showed our faces, filmed ten minutes ago, right here on this street.
Someone had been watching before we arrived.
sentences.cn: 有人在我们到达之前就一直在监视。

sentences.en: The timestamp was wrong — or worse, it was right.
sentences.cn: 时间戳要么是错的——要么更糟，它是对的。

prevent:1.en: Zero's drones swept low over the market. Ali pulled me behind a stack of crates. 'Stay down,' she hissed. Every exit was being watched. Grey Crow had warned us: once Zero locked a signal, nothing could *prevent* the trace from completing. We had ninety seconds, maybe less.
prevent:1.cnHint: 阿里拼命拉住我躲避无人机，但灰鸦说什么都无法____信号追踪完成。
prevent:1.hook: The drone paused directly overhead, its red eye blinking slowly.
prevent:1.line: 'Nothing can *prevent* the lock — we move now or we don't move.'

sentences.en: Zero's drones swept low over the market.
sentences.cn: 零点的无人机在集市上空低速扫过。

sentences.en: Ali pulled me behind a stack of crates.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把我拉到一堆板条箱后面。

sentences.en: 'Stay down,' she hissed.
sentences.cn: "蹲下，"她低声说。

sentences.en: Every exit was being watched.
sentences.cn: 每个出口都有人把守。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us: once Zero locked a signal, nothing could *prevent* the trace from completing.
We had ninety seconds, maybe less.
sentences.cn: 我们只有九十秒，也许更少。

source:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the underpass wall from floor to ceiling. Grey Crow ran his finger along one glowing line. 'Every signal in Harbor City traces back to a single *source*,' he said quietly. Ali and I exchanged a look. If that was true, Zero wasn't just a hacker. Zero was the signal itself.
source:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在通道墙上发现，全城所有信号都来自同一个____。
source:1.hook: The glowing line pulsed once, then spelled out my name.
source:1.line: 'Find the *source*, and you find everything Zero has ever hidden.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered the underpass wall from floor to ceiling.
sentences.cn: 编码涂鸦从地板铺满了地下通道的天花板。

sentences.en: Grey Crow ran his finger along one glowing line.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用手指沿着一条发光的线条滑动。

sentences.en: 'Every signal in Harbor City traces back to a single *source*,' he said quietly.
Ali and I exchanged a look.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我交换了一个眼神。

sentences.en: If that was true, Zero wasn't just a hacker.
sentences.cn: 如果那是真的，零点不仅仅是个黑客。

sentences.en: Zero was the signal itself.
sentences.cn: 零点就是信号本身。

available:1.en: The safe-house door was sealed. I ran every override code Grey Crow had given me — nothing worked. Ali checked her device. 'Only one exit is still *available*,' she said, pointing at a rusted grate above a flooded drain. I looked at the black water below. It was not a good option. It was the only one.
available:1.cnHint: 安全屋的出口几乎全被封锁，阿里说只有一条通道仍然____。
available:1.hook: Something moved beneath the water before I could decide.
available:1.line: 'This grate is the only exit still *available* — we take it now.'

sentences.en: The safe-house door was sealed.
sentences.cn: 安全屋的门被封住了。

sentences.en: I ran every override code Grey Crow had given me — nothing worked.
sentences.cn: 我试遍了灰鸦给我的每一个override密码——都不行。

sentences.en: Ali checked her device.
sentences.cn: 阿栗检查了她的设备。

sentences.en: 'Only one exit is still *available*,' she said, pointing at a rusted grate above a flooded drain.
I looked at the black water below.
sentences.cn: 我看着下面的黑水。

sentences.en: It was not a good option.
sentences.cn: 这不是个好选择。

sentences.en: It was the only one.
sentences.cn: 这是唯一的选择。

customer:1.en: The tea stall owner kept his eyes down as I approached. Ali had told me to act normal. I ordered one cup, nothing else. Grey Crow had said: every *customer* at this stall was already in Zero's system. I was now a data point. Somewhere, an algorithm was reading my face and making a decision.
customer:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，这个茶摊的每一位____都已经被录入零点的系统。
customer:1.hook: The owner slid a second cup toward me — I had ordered only one.
customer:1.line: 'Every *customer* here is a name on Zero's list — including you.'

sentences.en: The tea stall owner kept his eyes down as I approached.
sentences.cn: 茶摊老板在我走近时低着眼睛。

sentences.en: Ali had told me to act normal.
sentences.cn: 阿栗让我表现得自然点。

sentences.en: I ordered one cup, nothing else.
sentences.cn: 我只点了一杯茶。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had said: every *customer* at this stall was already in Zero's system.
I was now a data point.
sentences.cn: 我现在成了一个数据点。

sentences.en: Somewhere, an algorithm was reading my face and making a decision.
sentences.cn: 某个地方，有个算法在读我的脸，做出判断。

language:1.en: The broadcast cut through every channel at once. Not music, not static — structured sound. Ali pressed her earpiece tight. 'It's a *language*,' she said, eyes wide. 'But not one in any database.' Grey Crow had told us Zero could build new codes from nothing. We were hearing proof of that, live, on a wet street corner.
language:1.cnHint: 全频道突然传来一种奇异的____，阿里说任何数据库里都找不到它。
language:1.hook: Then the sound stopped — and something answered it from underground.
language:1.line: 'That is a *language* Zero invented so no one else could ever read it.'

sentences.en: The broadcast cut through every channel at once.
sentences.cn: 广播同时冲破了所有频道。

sentences.en: Not music, not static — structured sound.
sentences.cn: 不是音乐，不是静电——有结构的声音。

sentences.en: Ali pressed her earpiece tight.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧按住她的耳机。

sentences.en: 'It's a *language*,' she said, eyes wide.
'But not one in any database.'
sentences.cn: "但不是任何数据库里有的语言。"

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told us Zero could build new codes from nothing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我们零点可以凭空制造新代码。

sentences.en: We were hearing proof of that, live, on a wet street corner.
sentences.cn: 我们正在一个雨湿的街角听到实时的证明。

test:1.en: Grey Crow set a small device on the pavement between us. 'One *test*,' he said. 'If the light turns blue, Zero is within two blocks. If it stays red, we have time.' We watched in silence. The rain tapped the ground around it. The light flickered. Then, slowly, it turned blue.
test:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在路面上放下装置，用这个____来判断零点是否就在附近。
test:1.hook: Blue light reflected in Grey Crow's eyes as he said, 'Run.'
test:1.line: 'This *test* has never been wrong — and right now it reads blue.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow set a small device on the pavement between us.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在我们中间的人行道上放下一个小装置。

sentences.en: 'One *test*,' he said.
'If the light turns blue, Zero is within two blocks.
sentences.cn: "如果灯变蓝，零点在两个街区以内。

sentences.en: If it stays red, we have time.'
sentences.cn: 如果它保持红色，我们还有时间。"

sentences.en: We watched in silence.
sentences.cn: 我们无言地看着。

sentences.en: The rain tapped the ground around it.
sentences.cn: 雨点击打着它周围的地面。

sentences.en: The light flickered.
sentences.cn: 灯闪烁了。

sentences.en: Then, slowly, it turned blue.
sentences.cn: 然后，缓缓地，它变成了蓝色。

save:1.en: The rain hit hard on Pier 9. Grey Crow pressed a cold chip into my hand. 'Every byte on this belongs to the resistance,' he said. I had sixty seconds to *save* the file before Zero's signal swept the dock and erased everything.
save:1.cnHint: 灰鸦把芯片交给我，要我在信号清除前把文件____下来。
save:1.hook: The sweep timer hit zero — and the chip went dark.
save:1.line: '*Save* it now, or we lose everything tonight.'

sentences.en: The rain hit hard on Pier 9.
sentences.cn: 雨在第9码头上砸得很凶。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a cold chip into my hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一个冷冰冰的芯片塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: 'Every byte on this belongs to the resistance,' he said.
sentences.cn: "这上面的每一个字节都属于抵抗组织，"他说。

sentences.en: I had sixty seconds to *save* the file before Zero's signal swept the dock and erased everything.

service:1.en: The public screen above Market Lane flickered. Grey Crow pointed at the glitch. 'That broadcast tower runs the city's emergency *service*,' he said quietly. Without it, no shelter alert, no clean water signal, nothing. Zero had planted a kill-switch inside the system, and we had maybe an hour.
service:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指着信号塔说，它负责全市的紧急____，而零点已在系统内埋下开关。
service:1.hook: Somewhere above us, the kill-switch began its countdown.
service:1.line: 'The *service* goes dark — the whole city goes blind.'

sentences.en: The public screen above Market Lane flickered.
sentences.cn: 市场街上方的公共屏幕闪烁了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed at the glitch.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指着那个故障。

sentences.en: 'That broadcast tower runs the city's emergency *service*,' he said quietly.
Without it, no shelter alert, no clean water signal, nothing.
sentences.cn: 没有它，就没有庇护所警报，没有清洁水信号，什么都没有。

sentences.en: Zero had planted a kill-switch inside the system, and we had maybe an hour.
sentences.cn: 零点在系统里植入了一个杀伤开关，我们大概还有一小时。

note:1.en: A folded paper lay under a broken lamp on Canal Street. I picked it up. One *note*, seven words in block letters: ZERO MOVES AT THE THIRD BELL. Ali appeared beside me, breath short. 'Someone inside Zero's ring left that,' she whispered. 'Someone wants us to win.'
note:1.cnHint: 我在街灯下捡到一张____，上面七个字暗示零点的行动时间。
note:1.hook: The third bell was only twenty minutes away.
note:1.line: 'Read the *note* again — every word matters here.'

sentences.en: A folded paper lay under a broken lamp on Canal Street.
sentences.cn: 一张折叠的纸在运河街一盏破损的灯下。

sentences.en: I picked it up.
sentences.cn: 我拿起来。

sentences.en: One *note*, seven words in block letters: ZERO MOVES AT THE THIRD BELL.
Ali appeared beside me, breath short.
sentences.cn: 阿栗出现在我身边，呼吸急促。

sentences.en: 'Someone inside Zero's ring left that,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "是零点内部的人留下的，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'Someone wants us to win.'
sentences.cn: "有人想让我们赢。"

probably:1.en: Fog swallowed the east end of Bridge Road. Ali studied the spray-painted arrows on the wall. 'Zero is *probably* watching this corner right now,' she said, voice flat. I checked the rooftops. Three shadows, too still to be pigeons. She was right, and we both knew running was no longer an option.
probably:1.cnHint: 阿栗看着墙上的涂鸦说，零点____就在附近监视我们。
probably:1.hook: One shadow on the rooftop raised a small antenna.

sentences.en: Fog swallowed the east end of Bridge Road.
sentences.cn: 雾吞没了桥路的东端。

sentences.en: Ali studied the spray-painted arrows on the wall.
sentences.cn: 阿栗研究着墙上喷漆的箭头。

sentences.en: 'Zero is *probably* watching this corner right now,' she said, voice flat.
I checked the rooftops.
sentences.cn: 我检查了屋顶。

sentences.en: Three shadows, too still to be pigeons.
sentences.cn: 三个影子，静得不像鸽子。

sentences.en: She was right, and we both knew running was no longer an option.
sentences.cn: 她说得对，我们都知道逃跑已经不是选项了。

strategy:1.en: Grey Crow spread a rough map on the wet hood of an abandoned truck on Volta Ave. 'Emotion gets you caught,' he said. 'You need a *strategy*.' He drew three routes with his finger. Two were traps. One was clear — but only for the next four minutes before Zero's patrol looped back.
strategy:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在地图上画出三条路线，强调我们必须有____，否则必被抓。
strategy:1.hook: His finger stopped on the one route I feared most.
strategy:1.line: 'A good *strategy* wins before the fight even starts.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a rough map on the wet hood of an abandoned truck on Volta Ave.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在伏尔泰街一辆废弃卡车的湿漉漉的引擎盖上展开了一张粗糙的地图。

sentences.en: 'Emotion gets you caught,' he said.
sentences.cn: "情绪会让你被抓，"他说。

sentences.en: 'You need a *strategy*.'
He drew three routes with his finger.
sentences.cn: 他用手指画了三条路线。

sentences.en: Two were traps.
sentences.cn: 两条是陷阱。

sentences.en: One was clear — but only for the next four minutes before Zero's patrol looped back.
sentences.cn: 一条是畅通的——但只有四分钟，之后零点的巡逻队会绕回来。

building:1.en: The old relay station was a grey concrete *building* wedged between two flooded lots on Shard Street. Ali said Zero's crew had used it for months as a broadcast hub. No windows lit up. No sound. But the antenna on the roof was spinning fast — someone was transmitting right now.
building:1.cnHint: 阿栗说零点的人把这栋____当作广播中枢，而天线正在高速旋转。
building:1.hook: A faint blue light blinked once behind the sealed front door.
building:1.line: 'That *building* holds the signal — and maybe Zero himself.'

sentences.en: The old relay station was a grey concrete *building* wedged between two flooded lots on Shard Street.
Ali said Zero's crew had used it for months as a broadcast hub.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说零点的人马已经用这个地方当广播中枢好几个月了。

sentences.en: No windows lit up.
sentences.cn: 没有一扇窗透出灯光。

sentences.en: No sound.
sentences.cn: 没有声音。

sentences.en: But the antenna on the roof was spinning fast — someone was transmitting right now.
sentences.cn: 但屋顶上的天线在飞速旋转——有人正在实时传输。

community:1.en: The Neon Ward *community* had gone silent overnight. No vendor cries, no kids on the corner steps. Ali walked ahead, scanning doorways. Grey Crow had warned us: when an entire neighbourhood shuts down without a storm, Zero owns the block. Something had been promised — or threatened — to every single family here.
community:1.cnHint: 霓虹区的整个____一夜之间陷入沉默，阿栗说这意味着零点已控制了这里。
community:1.hook: A curtain moved — and a child's face vanished from the glass.
community:1.line: 'When a *community* goes quiet, the danger is loudest.'

sentences.en: The Neon Ward *community* had gone silent overnight.
No vendor cries, no kids on the corner steps.
sentences.cn: 没有小贩的叫卖声，街角台阶上没有小孩。

sentences.en: Ali walked ahead, scanning doorways.
sentences.cn: 阿栗走在前面，扫视着每一道门。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us: when an entire neighbourhood shuts down without a storm, Zero owns the block.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我们：整个街区一夜之间陷入死寂，不是因为风暴，那就是零点控制了这片地盘。

sentences.en: Something had been promised — or threatened — to every single family here.
sentences.cn: 每一户人家都被许诺过什么——或者被威胁过什么。

internet:1.en: Grey Crow crouched by a junction box on Filter Lane. 'Zero doesn't need the public *internet*,' he said, pulling a wire loose. 'He built his own — runs under these streets, invisible to every city scanner.' I stared at the humming cable in his hand. We had been searching the wrong network all along.
internet:1.cnHint: 灰鸦发现零点建了独立的____，藏在街道地下，根本不用公共网络。
