internet:1.hook: The cable in his hand pulsed once — then sent a signal out.
internet:1.line: 'His *internet* lives underground, beyond any scanner we have.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow crouched by a junction box on Filter Lane.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在过滤巷的一个接线盒旁。

sentences.en: 'Zero doesn't need the public *internet*,' he said, pulling a wire loose.
'He built his own — runs under these streets, invisible to every city scanner.'
sentences.cn: "他自己搭了一套——就在这些街道下面运行，任何城市扫描器都发现不了。"

sentences.en: I stared at the humming cable in his hand.
sentences.cn: 我盯着他手里嗡嗡作响的电缆。

sentences.en: We had been searching the wrong network all along.
sentences.cn: 我们一直在搜错了网络。

seek:1.en: The rain hit the pavement like static. I moved fast through the back streets of Harbor City, dodging signal-jammers and wet neon shadows. Grey Crow had told me to *seek* the source of the dead broadcast — a frequency that had gone silent three hours ago. Nobody else was looking.
seek:1.cnHint: 我在街头____一个神秘消失的信号源。
seek:1.hook: Then I found the antenna — still warm.
seek:1.line: '*Seek* the signal before Zero does,' Grey Crow whispered.

sentences.en: The rain hit the pavement like static.
sentences.cn: 雨水砸在路面上，像静电噪音一样。

sentences.en: I moved fast through the back streets of Harbor City, dodging signal-jammers and wet neon shadows.
sentences.cn: 我快速穿过港城的后街，躲避信号干扰器和湿漉漉的霓虹阴影。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me to *seek* the source of the dead broadcast — a frequency that had gone silent three hours ago.
Nobody else was looking.
sentences.cn: 没有其他人在找。

exist:1.en: The coded graffiti on the wall said the safe channel no longer *existed*. Ali pressed her back against the wet concrete and shook her head. 'They erased it,' she said. Around us the street hummed with false signals, ghost traffic, and the quiet noise of a city hiding something big.
exist:1.cnHint: 那条安全频道已经不再____了。
exist:1.hook: But erased things leave marks — and I saw one.
exist:1.line: 'If it does not *exist*, then who sent us here?'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti on the wall said the safe channel no longer *existed*.
Ali pressed her back against the wet concrete and shook her head.
sentences.cn: 阿栗贴着湿淋淋的混凝土墙，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'They erased it,' she said.
sentences.cn: "他们抹掉了，"她说。

sentences.en: Around us the street hummed with false signals, ghost traffic, and the quiet noise of a city hiding something big.
sentences.cn: 我们周围的街道充斥着虚假信号、幽灵流量，还有一座隐瞒着什么大事件的城市那种低沉的噪音。

supply:1.en: The drop point was a broken vending machine at the end of Crane Street. Grey Crow had promised a *supply* of clean signal chips — enough to keep us off the city grid for a week. The machine door hung open. The chips were gone. In their place: a single folded note.
supply:1.cnHint: 联络人承诺的物资____已经不见了。
supply:1.hook: The note had only two words: 'Run now.'
supply:1.line: 'Without that *supply*, we are blind out here,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The drop point was a broken vending machine at the end of Crane Street.
sentences.cn: 交接点是鹤街尽头一台坏掉的自动贩卖机。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had promised a *supply* of clean signal chips — enough to keep us off the city grid for a week.
The machine door hung open.
sentences.cn: 机器的门敞开着。

sentences.en: The chips were gone.
sentences.cn: 芯片不见了。

sentences.en: In their place: a single folded note.
sentences.cn: 取而代之的是一张折叠起来的纸条。

visit:1.en: My *visit* to the lower market was meant to last ten minutes — buy a signal mask, disappear. But the stall owner took one look at my badge and froze. Three streets away, sirens started. Ali pulled my sleeve and pointed to a camera above us, its red eye blinking fast.
visit:1.cnHint: 我对下层市场的____引起了不必要的注意。
visit:1.hook: The camera turned — and pointed straight at me.
visit:1.line: 'A *visit* this short should not draw that kind of crowd.'

sentences.en: My *visit* to the lower market was meant to last ten minutes — buy a signal mask, disappear.
But the stall owner took one look at my badge and froze.
sentences.cn: 但摊主看了一眼我的证件就僵住了。

sentences.en: Three streets away, sirens started.
sentences.cn: 三条街外，警笛响了起来。

sentences.en: Ali pulled my sleeve and pointed to a camera above us, its red eye blinking fast.
sentences.cn: 阿栗扯了扯我的袖子，指向我们上方的摄像头，它的红眼睛在飞快地闪烁。

worry:1.en: Ali said there was no reason to *worry* about the checkpoint on Gate Nine. She had used that route a dozen times. But as we turned the corner, the gate was ringed with new scanners, blue light washing over every face in the line. I felt the chip in my pocket grow heavy.
worry:1.cnHint: 阿栗说不必____，但检查站已经变了。
worry:1.hook: One scanner locked onto me and did not move.
worry:1.line: 'My *worry* is not the gate — it is what waits past it.'

sentences.en: Ali said there was no reason to *worry* about the checkpoint on Gate Nine.
She had used that route a dozen times.
sentences.cn: 她用过那条路十多次了。

sentences.en: But as we turned the corner, the gate was ringed with new scanners, blue light washing over every face in the line.
sentences.cn: 但我们转过街角时，大门周围密密麻麻都是新型扫描器，蓝光洗过队伍里每一张脸。

sentences.en: I felt the chip in my pocket grow heavy.
sentences.cn: 我感到口袋里的芯片沉甸甸的。

adapt:1.en: Zero changed his signal pattern every six hours. To survive on these streets you had to *adapt* just as fast — new masks, new routes, new code names. I had been in Harbor City for eight days. My old habits were already a danger. Grey Crow had warned me on day one.
adapt:1.cnHint: 在这座城市里，你必须快速____，否则就会被发现。
adapt:1.hook: Day nine, and Zero had already changed again.
adapt:1.line: '*Adapt* or get caught — those are the only two choices here.'

sentences.en: Zero changed his signal pattern every six hours.
sentences.cn: 零点每六小时改一次信号模式。

sentences.en: To survive on these streets you had to *adapt* just as fast — new masks, new routes, new code names.
I had been in Harbor City for eight days.
sentences.cn: 我在港城呆了八天。

sentences.en: My old habits were already a danger.
sentences.cn: 我的老习惯已经成了威胁。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me on day one.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦第一天就警告过我。

bit:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a *bit* of torn foil — no bigger than a fingernail — and told me it held the entire route map, compressed into a single light pulse. I almost laughed. Around us the night market roared and flickered, and nobody gave a second look to two people sharing something so small.
bit:1.cnHint: 引路人给了我一小____关键数据，藏在一片碎箔纸里。
bit:1.hook: Small enough to swallow — and I might have to.
bit:1.line: 'That *bit* of foil is worth more than this whole street.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a *bit* of torn foil — no bigger than a fingernail — and told me it held the entire route map, compressed into a single light pulse.
I almost laughed.
sentences.cn: 我差点笑出来。

sentences.en: Around us the night market roared and flickered, and nobody gave a second look to two people sharing something so small.
sentences.cn: 我们周围的夜市喧嚣闪烁，没人会多看两眼两个人交换这么小的东西。

check:1.en: I stopped under a broken light on Silk Road and *checked* the signal map one more time. The route Ali had marked was clean — no jammers, no patrols. But one node near the east wall blinked amber, not green. Grey Crow had told me: amber means someone was there recently. Very recently.
check:1.cnHint: 我在街角____信号地图，发现了一个可疑节点。
check:1.hook: Amber turned red while I was still watching.
check:1.line: '*Check* it twice — once is how people disappear in this city.'

sentences.en: I stopped under a broken light on Silk Road and *checked* the signal map one more time.
The route Ali had marked was clean — no jammers, no patrols.
sentences.cn: 阿栗标记的路线很干净——没有干扰器，没有巡逻队。

sentences.en: But one node near the east wall blinked amber, not green.
sentences.cn: 但东墙附近的一个节点闪烁的是琥珀色，不是绿色。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me: amber means someone was there recently.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦跟我说过：琥珀色意味着最近有人在那里。

sentences.en: Very recently.
sentences.cn: 非常最近。

easily:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Signal Row. Grey Crow handed me a stolen broadcast chip. 'This code could *easily* lead Zero straight to us,' he warned, eyes scanning the glowing graffiti on the wall. Every neon sign felt like a trap waiting to close. I pocketed the chip anyway.
easily:1.cnHint: 格雷·克罗警告我，这枚芯片____让零察觉到我们的位置。
easily:1.hook: Somewhere behind us, wet footsteps matched our own.
easily:1.line: 'This chip could *easily* get us both killed tonight.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Signal Row.
sentences.cn: 雨水砸在信号街外那条裂开的路上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a stolen broadcast chip.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一块被偷来的广播芯片。

sentences.en: 'This code could *easily* lead Zero straight to us,' he warned, eyes scanning the glowing graffiti on the wall.
Every neon sign felt like a trap waiting to close.
sentences.cn: 每一个霓虹招牌都像一个等着合上的陷阱。

sentences.en: I pocketed the chip anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是把芯片放进了口袋。

protect:1.en: Ali pulled me behind a rusted signal tower at the edge of Neon Wharf. 'Stay low,' she said. The tower's old jamming field could *protect* us from Zero's scanner drones for maybe three minutes. Rain hissed against hot metal. Three minutes felt like nothing at all.
protect:1.cnHint: 阿里找到一座旧信号塔，试图用它____我们不被无人机发现。
protect:1.hook: One drone broke from the pack and turned our way.
protect:1.line: 'This tower can *protect* us — but only for three minutes.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled me behind a rusted signal tower at the edge of Neon Wharf.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把我拉到霓虹码头边缘一座生锈的信号塔后面。

sentences.en: 'Stay low,' she said.
sentences.cn: "趴低，"她说。

sentences.en: The tower's old jamming field could *protect* us from Zero's scanner drones for maybe three minutes.
Rain hissed against hot metal.
sentences.cn: 雨声嘶鸣着敲打滚烫的金属。

sentences.en: Three minutes felt like nothing at all.
sentences.cn: 三分钟感觉什么都不是。

advantage:1.en: Zero had chosen the high walkway above Market Alley, and I understood why immediately. From up there he could see every exit. The elevation was a clear *advantage*. Grey Crow gripped my arm and pointed to a lower maintenance path cutting under the walkway. 'We take that,' he said.
advantage:1.cnHint: 零占据了高处，这给了他明显的____，格雷·克罗示意走下方的通道。
advantage:1.hook: A shadow on the walkway stopped and looked directly down.
advantage:1.line: 'Height is his *advantage* — so we go underneath.'

sentences.en: Zero had chosen the high walkway above Market Alley, and I understood why immediately.
sentences.cn: 零点选在了菜市巷上方的高架走道上，我一下子就明白了为什么。

sentences.en: From up there he could see every exit.
sentences.cn: 从那儿他能看到每一个出口。

sentences.en: The elevation was a clear *advantage*.
Grey Crow gripped my arm and pointed to a lower maintenance path cutting under the walkway.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦抓住我的胳膊，指向走道下方的一条维修通道。

sentences.en: 'We take that,' he said.
sentences.cn: "我们走那儿，"他说。

break:1.en: The neon broadcast cut to static — a sudden *break* in the city's encrypted signal stream. Ali froze mid-step on the wet pavement. 'That never just happens,' she whispered. In Harbor City, a gap in the broadcast meant someone powerful had forced the silence. We both looked up at the dark sky.
break:1.cnHint: 城市加密信号突然出现____，阿里意识到这绝非偶然。
break:1.hook: Then one word crackled through the static: my name.
break:1.line: 'A *break* in the signal this clean is never an accident.'

sentences.en: The neon broadcast cut to static — a sudden *break* in the city's encrypted signal stream.
Ali froze mid-step on the wet pavement.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在湿漉漉的地面上突然停住了。

sentences.en: 'That never just happens,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "这种事从不会无缘无故发生，"她低声说。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, a gap in the broadcast meant someone powerful had forced the silence.
sentences.cn: 在港城，广播信号断裂意味着有什么大人物强行切断了声音。

sentences.en: We both looked up at the dark sky.
sentences.cn: 我们都抬头看向黑沉沉的天空。

conclude:1.en: I studied the coded graffiti sprayed across three walls of the underpass, reading the pattern left to right. Grey Crow watched me work. After a long silence, I could *conclude* only one thing: Zero had been here less than an hour ago and had left this message for me, not for anyone else.
conclude:1.cnHint: 我分析地下通道里的暗语涂鸦，终于____零刚刚到过这里。
conclude:1.hook: The paint was still wet under my fingertip.
conclude:1.line: 'From this pattern, I *conclude* he came here for you specifically.'

sentences.en: I studied the coded graffiti sprayed across three walls of the underpass, reading the pattern left to right.
sentences.cn: 我研究着下通道三面墙上喷的密码涂鸦，从左往右读着那个图案。

sentences.en: Grey Crow watched me work.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一旁看我破译。

sentences.en: After a long silence, I could *conclude* only one thing: Zero had been here less than an hour ago and had left this message for me, not for anyone else.

figure:1.en: Through the rain and smoke of the night market, I spotted a lone *figure* standing perfectly still between two food stalls. Everyone else moved — buyers, vendors, drones. This person did not. Ali touched my shoulder. 'That is not a shopper,' she said quietly. The figure turned its head toward us with slow precision.
figure:1.cnHint: 在嘈杂的夜市中，一个静止不动的____引起了我和阿里的注意。
figure:1.hook: It raised one hand and pointed directly at me.
figure:1.line: 'That *figure* hasn't moved in four minutes — watch it.'

sentences.en: Through the rain and smoke of the night market, I spotted a lone *figure* standing perfectly still between two food stalls.
Everyone else moved — buyers, vendors, drones.
sentences.cn: 其他人都在动——买家、小贩、无人机。

sentences.en: This person did not.
sentences.cn: 这个人没有。

sentences.en: Ali touched my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗碰了碰我的肩膀。

sentences.en: 'That is not a shopper,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "那不是顾客，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: The figure turned its head toward us with slow precision.
sentences.cn: 那个身影以缓慢精确的方式转向我们。

fit:1.en: Grey Crow passed me a secondhand signal coat from a streetside rack. 'Put this on fast.' The coat had a hidden lining that could *fit* a broadcast chip without triggering port scanners. I pulled it on. It was two sizes large, but in Harbor City, invisibility mattered more than looking sharp.
fit:1.cnHint: 格雷·克罗给我一件夹层外套，它能____芯片而不触发扫描器。
fit:1.hook: The scanner arch at the alley exit flickered on.
fit:1.line: 'The lining can *fit* the chip without setting off the arch.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow passed me a secondhand signal coat from a streetside rack.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从街边一个货架上给我递来一件二手信号外套。

sentences.en: 'Put this on fast.'
sentences.cn: "快穿上。"

sentences.en: The coat had a hidden lining that could *fit* a broadcast chip without triggering port scanners.
I pulled it on.
sentences.cn: 我穿上了。

sentences.en: It was two sizes large, but in Harbor City, invisibility mattered more than looking sharp.
sentences.cn: 虽然大了两号，但在港城，隐身比看起来整洁更重要。

particular:1.en: Ali led me through six identical-looking back alleys before stopping at one *particular* wall. No graffiti, no neon, no markings I could see — yet she pressed her palm flat against the wet concrete with total certainty. 'Zero always leaves one clean wall,' she said. 'That means something is hidden here.'
particular:1.cnHint: 阿里在某一____的墙壁前停下，坚信零在此处藏了秘密。
particular:1.hook: The wall gave a low hum under her hand.
particular:1.line: 'This *particular* wall — Zero always leaves one clean.'

sentences.en: Ali led me through six identical-looking back alleys before stopping at one *particular* wall.
No graffiti, no neon, no markings I could see — yet she pressed her palm flat against the wet concrete with total certainty.
sentences.cn: 没有涂鸦，没有霓虹，没有我能看到的任何标记——但她却用绝对的把握把掌心贴在湿润的混凝土上。

sentences.en: 'Zero always leaves one clean wall,' she said.
sentences.cn: "零点总会留一面干净的墙，"她说。

sentences.en: 'That means something is hidden here.'
sentences.cn: "这意味着这儿藏着什么东西。"

stick:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower. Grey Crow pressed a small device against the wall and said it would *stick* there for hours. Ali watched the alley for movement. The device had to hold — one loose patch and the whole intercept would fail before Zero even arrived.
stick:1.cnHint: 灰鸦把一个装置____在信号塔外墙上，等待零点出现。
stick:1.hook: Then the wall began to vibrate.
stick:1.line: 'It will *stick*, trust the adhesive — do not touch it.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在信号塔外的街道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a small device against the wall and said it would *stick* there for hours.
Ali watched the alley for movement.
sentences.cn: 阿栗守着小巷的动静。

sentences.en: The device had to hold — one loose patch and the whole intercept would fail before Zero even arrived.
sentences.cn: 这个装置必须稳住——哪怕一丝松动，整个截获行动都会在零点到达前崩盘。

effective:1.en: Ali handed me a new signal filter. 'Old scanners miss Zero's channel,' she said. The filter was small, barely the size of a coin, but Grey Crow had assured us it was the most *effective* tool in the city for cutting through encrypted street noise. I clipped it on and listened.
effective:1.cnHint: 阿栗给了我一个新的信号过滤器，据说是全城最____的。
effective:1.hook: The first sound I caught was my own name.
effective:1.line: 'This filter is the most *effective* one left — use it carefully.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me a new signal filter.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一个新的信号过滤器。

sentences.en: 'Old scanners miss Zero's channel,' she said.
sentences.cn: "旧扫描仪抓不到零点的频道，"她说。

sentences.en: The filter was small, barely the size of a coin, but Grey Crow had assured us it was the most *effective* tool in the city for cutting through encrypted street noise.
I clipped it on and listened.
sentences.cn: 我夹上它，开始侦听。

fear:1.en: The neon signs above Pier 9 flickered in the rain. I had tracked Zero's signal to this block three nights in a row. Grey Crow told me once that *fear* is just a signal your body sends when the data does not add up. Tonight the data added up to something I did not want to face.
fear:1.cnHint: 我在9号码头追踪零点的信号，内心的____越来越重。
fear:1.hook: A shadow stepped out from behind the last sign.
fear:1.line: '*Fear* means the signal is real — keep moving.'

sentences.en: The neon signs above Pier 9 flickered in the rain.
sentences.cn: 九号码头上方的霓虹招牌在雨中闪烁。

sentences.en: I had tracked Zero's signal to this block three nights in a row.
sentences.cn: 我已经连续三个晚上把零点的信号追踪到这个街区。

sentences.en: Grey Crow told me once that *fear* is just a signal your body sends when the data does not add up.
Tonight the data added up to something I did not want to face.
sentences.cn: 今晚数据加起来指向一件我不想面对的事。

hit:1.en: Zero's broadcast *hit* the open channel at midnight exactly. The sound cracked through my earpiece like static turned sharp. Ali froze beside me on the wet pavement. Grey Crow had warned us the signal would be fast, but nothing prepared me for how hard those two seconds of code landed.
hit:1.cnHint: 零点的信号在午夜____了开放频道，声音震得我耳膜生疼。
hit:1.hook: The code inside contained only one word: my address.
hit:1.line: 'When it *hits*, record every millisecond — nothing gets lost.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast *hit* the open channel at midnight exactly.
The sound cracked through my earpiece like static turned sharp.
sentences.cn: 声音像尖锐化的静电从我的耳机里炸裂开来。

sentences.en: Ali froze beside me on the wet pavement.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我身边的湿地面上僵住了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us the signal would be fast, but nothing prepared me for how hard those two seconds of code landed.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我信号会很快，但没什么能让我做好准备去承受那两秒代码的冲击力。

assume:1.en: I reached the crossroads first and waited. Grey Crow was late, which never happened. It was easy to *assume* the route was safe — the street looked empty, the cameras were dark — but Zero had taught this city that empty streets are the loudest traps of all.
assume:1.cnHint: 我站在十字路口，不能____这条路是安全的。
assume:1.hook: One camera turned, slow and deliberate, toward me.
assume:1.line: 'Never *assume* a dark street is a safe one.'

sentences.en: I reached the crossroads first and waited.
sentences.cn: 我最先到达十字路口并等待。

sentences.en: Grey Crow was late, which never happened.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦迟到了，这从不会发生。

sentences.en: It was easy to *assume* the route was safe — the street looked empty, the cameras were dark — but Zero had taught this city that empty streets are the loudest traps of all.

generally:1.en: Coded graffiti covers *generally* every surface near the old port market, so most people walk past without a second look. But Grey Crow had taught me the three symbols that mean a dead drop is active. Tonight all three glowed faintly under the rain, fresh paint still running.
generally:1.cnHint: 旧港市场附近____到处是暗语涂鸦，今晚那三个关键符号亮了。
generally:1.hook: Underneath the symbols was an arrow pointing straight down.
generally:1.line: '*Generally* they use two marks — three means the drop is urgent.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covers *generally* every surface near the old port market, so most people walk past without a second look.
But Grey Crow had taught me the three symbols that mean a dead drop is active.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦教过我三个符号，意思是死信箱已激活。

sentences.en: Tonight all three glowed faintly under the rain, fresh paint still running.
sentences.cn: 今晚这三个符号在雨中隐隐发光，新漆料还在往下流。

interaction:1.en: Grey Crow pulled me back from the street terminal. 'Every *interaction* with a city node is logged,' he said quietly. A screen on the terminal still showed my last query, glowing white in the rain. Somewhere in the network, Zero's system had already flagged the timestamp and started a trace.
interaction:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，与城市终端的每一次____都会被记录和追踪。
interaction:1.hook: The trace reached my location in under four seconds.
interaction:1.line: 'One *interaction* with that node and they own your position.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me back from the street terminal.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我从街角终端机前拉开。

sentences.en: 'Every *interaction* with a city node is logged,' he said quietly.
A screen on the terminal still showed my last query, glowing white in the rain.
sentences.cn: 终端机的屏幕还显示着我上次的查询，在雨中泛着白光。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the network, Zero's system had already flagged the timestamp and started a trace.
sentences.cn: 在某处的网络深处，零点的系统已经标记了时间戳，开始追踪。

top:1.en: Ali climbed to the *top* of the signal relay box at the end of the bridge and held up her scanner. From down on the wet street I could see her silhouette sharp against the orange sky. She had three minutes before the patrol drone completed its loop and came back around.
top:1.cnHint: 阿栗爬上桥头信号中继箱的____，用扫描仪搜寻目标频率。
top:1.hook: The drone's light appeared at the far end of the bridge.
top:1.line: 'From the *top* I can read all four channels at once — just cover me.'

sentences.en: Ali climbed to the *top* of the signal relay box at the end of the bridge and held up her scanner.
From down on the wet street I could see her silhouette sharp against the orange sky.
sentences.cn: 我在潮湿的街道上往上看，能看到她的身影在橙色天空的映衬下清晰可见。

sentences.en: She had three minutes before the patrol drone completed its loop and came back around.
sentences.cn: 她只有三分钟，巡逻无人机转完一圈就会飞回来。

consequence:1.en: The coded graffiti covered every wall in the Lower Port district. Grey Crow pointed at a string of symbols near a drain pipe. 'Someone painted this at great risk,' he said. 'That means the *consequence* of ignoring it is worse than getting caught.' I pulled out my scanner and got to work.
consequence:1.cnHint: 引路人警告我，忽视这条暗语涂鸦的____比被抓更可怕。
consequence:1.hook: The scanner beeped once, then went completely silent.
consequence:1.line: 'The *consequence* of doing nothing tonight will follow you forever.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered every wall in the Lower Port district.
sentences.cn: 编码涂鸦覆盖了下港区的每一面墙。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed at a string of symbols near a drain pipe.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向排水管附近的一串符号。

sentences.en: 'Someone painted this at great risk,' he said.
sentences.cn: "有人冒着很大的风险画了这个，"他说。

sentences.en: 'That means the *consequence* of ignoring it is worse than getting caught.'
I pulled out my scanner and got to work.
sentences.cn: 我掏出扫描仪开始工作。

realize:1.en: Rain hammered the neon-lit street outside Sector Nine. I watched the coded broadcast flash across a public screen for the third time. Then it hit me — I began to *realize* that the repeated signal was not a glitch. It was a countdown. Ali grabbed my arm before I could speak.
realize:1.cnHint: 我盯着公共屏幕上反复闪烁的加密广告，终于____到那是一个倒计时。
realize:1.hook: Ali's grip tightened, and she whispered a single number: three.
realize:1.line: 'Do you *realize* what that signal has been telling us all night?'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the neon-lit street outside Sector Nine.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在九号区外的霓虹灯街道上。

sentences.en: I watched the coded broadcast flash across a public screen for the third time.
sentences.cn: 我看着编码广播在公共屏幕上第三次闪过。

sentences.en: Then it hit me — I began to *realize* that the repeated signal was not a glitch.
It was a countdown.
sentences.cn: 这是一个倒计时。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm before I could speak.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我还没来得及开口时就抓住了我的胳膊。

mostly:1.en: Grey Crow led me through the market at the edge of Canal Row. The stalls were *mostly* dark at this hour, steel shutters pulled low. But a few vendors still traded in whispers — forbidden words printed on slips of paper, passed under the counter like old coins. Zero had to be nearby.
mostly:1.cnHint: 引路人带我穿过运河边的市场，这里的摊位____都已关闭，但仍有人在暗中交易禁语。
mostly:1.hook: One vendor looked up, recognised me, and ran.
mostly:1.line: 'The traders here are *mostly* working for Zero — trust none of them.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow led me through the market at the edge of Canal Row.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦带我穿过运河街边缘的市集。

sentences.en: The stalls were *mostly* dark at this hour, steel shutters pulled low.
But a few vendors still traded in whispers — forbidden words printed on slips of paper, passed under the counter like old coins.
sentences.cn: 但还有几个小贩在窃窃私语交易——禁词印在纸条上，像古老的硬币一样从柜台下传递。

sentences.en: Zero had to be nearby.
sentences.cn: 零点一定就在附近。

exactly:1.en: I found the drop point *exactly* where the coded map said it would be: a cracked lamppost at the corner of Drift Street and Wire Lane. The small metal box was still warm. Someone had been here seconds ago. Footprints in the wet concrete led south toward the bridge.
exactly:1.cnHint: 我在加密地图标示的地点，____找到了那个还温热的金属盒子。
exactly:1.hook: The footprints stopped at the edge of the bridge — and vanished.
exactly:1.line: 'This is *exactly* the kind of trap Zero loves to set for rookies like you.'

sentences.en: I found the drop point *exactly* where the coded map said it would be: a cracked lamppost at the corner of Drift Street and Wire Lane.
The small metal box was still warm.
sentences.cn: 那个小金属盒子还是温的。

sentences.en: Someone had been here seconds ago.
sentences.cn: 有人几秒前才来过这里。

sentences.en: Footprints in the wet concrete led south toward the bridge.
sentences.cn: 潮湿的混凝土上的脚印向南指向大桥。

vary:1.en: Ali studied the graffiti tags across the overpass walls. 'The cipher patterns *vary* from block to block,' she said, voice tight. 'Someone is changing the code on purpose — maybe to confuse scanners, maybe to send a second message inside the first.' The rain picked up, washing one tag away before we could read it.
vary:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现高架桥上的密码涂鸦每隔一段就会____，这绝非偶然。
vary:1.hook: The tag that vanished had contained a name — our names.
vary:1.line: 'The codes *vary* because someone out there does not want us to follow the trail.'

sentences.en: Ali studied the graffiti tags across the overpass walls.
sentences.cn: 阿栗研究着高架桥墙上的涂鸦标记。

sentences.en: 'The cipher patterns *vary* from block to block,' she said, voice tight.
'Someone is changing the code on purpose — maybe to confuse scanners, maybe to send a second message inside the first.'
sentences.cn: "有人故意改密码——也许是为了迷惑扫描仪，也许是为了在第一条信息里藏第二条。"

sentences.en: The rain picked up, washing one tag away before we could read it.
sentences.cn: 雨下得更大了，冲掉了一个标记，我们还没来得及读。

brain:1.en: Zero's broadcast crackled through the street speaker above the checkpoint. 'A strong *brain* can crack any lock,' the voice said, smooth and cold. 'Let's see if yours is strong enough.' Pedestrians froze. I kept walking, eyes forward, pretending I had not heard my own name buried in the static.
brain:1.cnHint: 零点的广播在检查站上方响起，公开挑战我的____，路人纷纷驻足。
brain:1.hook: My name in the static meant Zero already knew my route.
brain:1.line: 'Your *brain* is the only weapon worth stealing in this city, rookie.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast crackled through the street speaker above the checkpoint.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播从检查站上方的街道喇叭里噼啪作响。

sentences.en: 'A strong *brain* can crack any lock,' the voice said, smooth and cold.
'Let's see if yours is strong enough.'
sentences.cn: "看看你的脑子够不够聪明。"

sentences.en: Pedestrians froze.
sentences.cn: 行人都僵住了。

sentences.en: I kept walking, eyes forward, pretending I had not heard my own name buried in the static.
sentences.cn: 我继续走，眼睛朝前，假装没在静电里听到自己的名字。

stress:1.en: The protest zone near Gate Eleven was thick with noise and damp air. Official signs along the fence put heavy *stress* on the phrase 'authorised speech only' — the city's way of warning that even the wrong word could get you detained. I spotted Ali slipping a note into a crack in the wall.
stress:1.cnHint: 栅栏旁的官方标牌对"授权语言"一词加以重点____，提醒所有人言语有风险。
stress:1.hook: Ali's note disappeared into the crack just as a patrol light swept past.
stress:1.line: 'They put *stress* on those words to hide what they are truly afraid of.'

sentences.en: The protest zone near Gate Eleven was thick with noise and damp air.
sentences.cn: 十一号门附近的抗议区充满了噪音和潮湿的空气。

sentences.en: Official signs along the fence put heavy *stress* on the phrase 'authorised speech only' — the city's way of warning that even the wrong word could get you detained.
I spotted Ali slipping a note into a crack in the wall.
sentences.cn: 我看到阿栗把一张纸条塞进了墙上的一条裂缝里。

financial:1.en: Grey Crow stopped at the bulletin board outside the Exchange Tower. The screen showed nothing but *financial* data — stock lines, transfer codes, currency rates. 'Zero hides messages inside the numbers,' he murmured. 'Every spike in the figures is a letter.' I looked closer. Three spikes. Three letters. Run.
financial:1.cnHint: 引路人指着交易所外的金融数据屏幕，告诉我零点把密信藏在那些____数字里。
financial:1.hook: The three letters formed a word I never wanted to read here: run.
financial:1.line: 'Anyone who controls the *financial* feed controls every secret in this city.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped at the bulletin board outside the Exchange Tower.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在交易塔外的公告栏前停下。

sentences.en: The screen showed nothing but *financial* data — stock lines, transfer codes, currency rates.
'Zero hides messages inside the numbers,' he murmured.
sentences.cn: "零点把信息藏在数字里，"他低声说。

sentences.en: 'Every spike in the figures is a letter.'
sentences.cn: "图表上的每一个尖峰都是一个字母。"

sentences.en: I looked closer.
sentences.cn: 我凑近看。

sentences.en: Three spikes.
sentences.cn: 三个尖峰。

sentences.en: Three letters.
sentences.cn: 三个字母。

sentences.en: Run.
sentences.cn: 跑。

fruit:1.en: The night market on Deck Nine smelled of rain and something sweet. A vendor's cart had been flipped. Crushed *fruit* lay across the wet concrete, red and orange, like a warning painted by someone in a hurry. Grey Crow crouched beside it and picked up a small data chip hidden under a bruised mango.
fruit:1.cnHint: 九号甲板的夜市摊位被掀翻，灰鸦在散落的____下发现了一枚数据芯片。
fruit:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'The *fruit* was cover — someone left this for us.'

sentences.en: The night market on Deck Nine smelled of rain and something sweet.
sentences.cn: 九层甲板的夜间市集闻起来像雨水和某种甜味。

sentences.en: A vendor's cart had been flipped.
sentences.cn: 一辆小贩的推车被翻了。

sentences.en: Crushed *fruit* lay across the wet concrete, red and orange, like a warning painted by someone in a hurry.
Grey Crow crouched beside it and picked up a small data chip hidden under a bruised mango.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在旁边，从一个被压伤的芒果下面捡起一块小数据芯片。

waste:1.en: Ali grabbed my arm at the corner of Signal Row. 'Don't *waste* your signal ping on that tower,' she said, eyes fixed on a black drone circling above. The tower was a trap, its broadcast looping fake data to pull rookies in. I lowered my device and followed her into the fog.
waste:1.cnHint: 阿栗警告我不要在那座信号塔上____宝贵的信号探测，因为那是个陷阱。
waste:1.hook: Behind us, someone else triggered the trap.
waste:1.line: Ali whispered, 'Don't *waste* your one clean ping on a ghost signal.'

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm at the corner of Signal Row.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在信号街的转角抓住了我的胳膊。

sentences.en: 'Don't *waste* your signal ping on that tower,' she said, eyes fixed on a black drone circling above.
The tower was a trap, its broadcast looping fake data to pull rookies in.
sentences.cn: 那座塔是个陷阱，广播循环播放虚假数据，专门诱骗菜鸟。

sentences.en: I lowered my device and followed her into the fog.
sentences.cn: 我放下了设备，跟着她走进了雾里。

learning:1.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall on East Canal Street. Each symbol was a lesson in the old cipher system, the kind banned after the Signal Riots. Grey Crow ran a gloved finger along the marks. 'This is *learning* that the city wants buried,' he said. My recorder caught every line.
learning:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在地下通道的墙上发现了被禁止的密码符号，那是城市想要掩埋的____。
learning:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'This *learning* was outlawed for a reason — read it fast.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall on East Canal Street.
sentences.cn: 地下通道东运河街的墙上布满了密码涂鸦。

sentences.en: Each symbol was a lesson in the old cipher system, the kind banned after the Signal Riots.
sentences.cn: 每个符号都是一堂课，来自信号暴动后被禁用的古老密码系统。

sentences.en: Grey Crow ran a gloved finger along the marks.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用戴手套的手指沿着这些标记划过。

sentences.en: 'This is *learning* that the city wants buried,' he said.
My recorder caught every line.
sentences.cn: 我的录音机记下了每一行。

manager:1.en: The name on the broken sign above the loading dock read ZONE 4 *MANAGER*. Locals said the man who held that post had vanished three nights ago. His office key was found taped beneath a trash bin outside. Ali turned it over slowly, reading the tiny code etched along its edge.
manager:1.cnHint: 四区的____三天前失踪了，阿栗在垃圾桶外找到了他办公室的钥匙。
manager:1.hook: The code on the key matched Zero's frequency.
manager:1.line: Ali said, 'The *manager* knew too much — that is why he is gone.'

sentences.en: The name on the broken sign above the loading dock read ZONE 4 *MANAGER*.
Locals said the man who held that post had vanished three nights ago.
sentences.cn: 本地人说那个职位的人三晚前消失了。

sentences.en: His office key was found taped beneath a trash bin outside.
sentences.cn: 他的办公室钥匙在外面的垃圾桶下面被胶带贴着。

sentences.en: Ali turned it over slowly, reading the tiny code etched along its edge.
sentences.cn: 阿栗慢慢翻动钥匙，读着刻在边上的微小编码。

knowledge:1.en: Street preachers in Harbor City sell two things: fake food tokens and old *knowledge*. This one was different. He spoke in a low, flat voice about the sub-layer broadcast grid, details no street preacher should have. I recorded six seconds before Zero's signal jammer cut my feed dead.
knowledge:1.cnHint: 一个街头布道者掌握着不该有的____，我的录音在零点的信号干扰器介入前只捕捉到六秒。
knowledge:1.line: The preacher said, 'True *knowledge* in this city will get you killed or saved.'

sentences.en: Street preachers in Harbor City sell two things: fake food tokens and old *knowledge*.
This one was different.
sentences.cn: 这个不一样。

sentences.en: He spoke in a low, flat voice about the sub-layer broadcast grid, details no street preacher should have.
sentences.cn: 他用低沉平板的声音讲述了副层广播网格的细节，这些东西不是街头传教者该知道的。

sentences.en: I recorded six seconds before Zero's signal jammer cut my feed dead.
sentences.cn: 我录了六秒钟，零点的信号干扰器就把我的信源切断了。

mental:1.en: Zero's messages were designed to cause *mental* static, fragments of sound and broken images pushed straight to your neural feed. Standing at the bus stop on Lumen Avenue, I felt the first pulse hit. Grey Crow had warned me. I bit down, steadied my breathing, and blocked the channel.
mental:1.cnHint: 站在Lumen大道的公交站，我感受到零点专门制造____干扰的信号脉冲第一次袭来。
mental:1.hook: The second pulse was already loading.
mental:1.line: Grey Crow warned, 'Zero builds *mental* noise to make you drop your guard first.'

sentences.en: Zero's messages were designed to cause *mental* static, fragments of sound and broken images pushed straight to your neural feed.
Standing at the bus stop on Lumen Avenue, I felt the first pulse hit.
sentences.cn: 站在光明大道的公交站，我感觉到了第一波冲击。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾经警告过我。

sentences.en: I bit down, steadied my breathing, and blocked the channel.
sentences.cn: 我咬紧牙关，稳定了呼吸，封闭了频道。

weight:1.en: The old broadcast antenna on the roof of Pier Street Station had been cut loose. I found it on the ground, its metal frame bent. Even broken, the *weight* of it told me it had not fallen — it had been lowered, carefully, by someone who knew what they were doing.
weight:1.cnHint: Pier街车站屋顶的天线被切断落地，它的____告诉我这不是意外坠落，而是有人刻意放下的。
weight:1.hook: Fresh tool marks shone in the lamplight.
weight:1.line: I said, 'The *weight* of this thing means at least two people moved it.'

sentences.en: The old broadcast antenna on the roof of Pier Street Station had been cut loose.
sentences.cn: 码头街车站屋顶上的老广播天线被剪断松开了。

sentences.en: I found it on the ground, its metal frame bent.
sentences.cn: 我在地上找到了它，金属框架被弯曲了。

sentences.en: Even broken, the *weight* of it told me it had not fallen — it had been lowered, carefully, by someone who knew what they were doing.

academic:1.en: The notice posted on the library gate looked official — department seal, clean font, *academic* language about a closed research seminar. But the address printed at the bottom did not exist. Ali scanned the seal. It was a forgery built to pass a fast glance and nothing more.
academic:1.cnHint: 图书馆门上张贴的通知用____措辞伪装成官方公告，但阿栗扫描后发现那枚印章是假的。
academic:1.hook: Someone wanted us to go to that address.
academic:1.line: Ali said, 'The *academic* tone is fake cover — Zero printed this himself.'

sentences.en: The notice posted on the library gate looked official — department seal, clean font, *academic* language about a closed research seminar.
But the address printed at the bottom did not exist.
sentences.cn: 但底部印的地址不存在。

sentences.en: Ali scanned the seal.
sentences.cn: 阿栗扫描了印章。

sentences.en: It was a forgery built to pass a fast glance and nothing more.
sentences.cn: 这是个伪造品，只能经得起匆匆一瞥。

prepare:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside the old signal tower. Grey Crow handed me a folded map and a dead-drop code. 'You have ten minutes,' he said. I started to *prepare* my kit: scanner, gloves, one clean ID chip. Somewhere above, a red light blinked twice and went dark.
prepare:1.cnHint: 灰鸦命令我在十分钟内____好装备，信号塔上的红灯突然熄灭。
prepare:1.hook: The red light never blinks twice unless someone is already watching.
prepare:1.line: '*Prepare* your kit before that light blinks again.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside the old signal tower.
sentences.cn: 雨砸向老信号塔外的街道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a folded map and a dead-drop code.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一张折好的地图和一个死信箱代码。

sentences.en: 'You have ten minutes,' he said.
sentences.cn: "你有十分钟，"他说。

sentences.en: I started to *prepare* my kit: scanner, gloves, one clean ID chip.
Somewhere above, a red light blinked twice and went dark.
sentences.cn: 上面某处，一盏红灯闪了两下，然后熄灭了。

workplace:1.en: The alley behind Neon Block Seven had once been a printer's yard. Now coded graffiti covered every wall — each tag a message, each colour a rank. Grey Crow called this stretch his *workplace*. I stepped in and felt the air change, thick with encrypted static and the smell of burnt wire.
workplace:1.cnHint: 灰鸦把这条布满密语涂鸦的小巷称作他的____。
workplace:1.hook: One tag on the far wall had been painted over — tonight.
workplace:1.line: 'Welcome to my *workplace* — read the walls, not the sky.'

sentences.en: The alley behind Neon Block Seven had once been a printer's yard.
sentences.cn: 霓虹第七区后面的小巷曾经是个印刷厂。

sentences.en: Now coded graffiti covered every wall — each tag a message, each colour a rank.
sentences.cn: 现在密码涂鸦覆盖了每面墙——每个标签都是一条信息，每种颜色代表一个等级。

sentences.en: Grey Crow called this stretch his *workplace*.
I stepped in and felt the air change, thick with encrypted static and the smell of burnt wire.
sentences.cn: 我走了进去，感觉空气变了，弥漫着加密的静电噪音和烧焦的金属味。

post:1.en: Ali crouched by the broken lamp post and pointed at a narrow slot cut into its base. Someone used it to *post* paper messages, old-style, untraceable. I pulled on gloves and reached inside. My fingers closed around a strip of film no wider than my thumb. The rain erased our footprints behind us.
post:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现有人在路灯底部的缝隙里____纸质情报。
post:1.hook: The film strip showed a face I already knew.
post:1.line: 'They *post* paper here because paper leaves no signal.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched by the broken lamp post and pointed at a narrow slot cut into its base.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在坏了的灯柱旁，指着柱子底部切出的一条狭缝。

sentences.en: Someone used it to *post* paper messages, old-style, untraceable.
I pulled on gloves and reached inside.
sentences.cn: 我戴上手套伸了进去。

sentences.en: My fingers closed around a strip of film no wider than my thumb.
sentences.cn: 我的手指握住了一卷胶片，宽度不超过我的大拇指。

sentences.en: The rain erased our footprints behind us.
sentences.cn: 雨水在我们身后抹去了脚印。

complete:1.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on the open channel. 'The grid map is not yours yet,' he said. I looked at the seven marked corners on my scanner — six were confirmed, one still dark. I had to *complete* the circuit before dawn or the whole network would reset and vanish.
complete:1.cnHint: 我必须在天亮前____线路图，否则整个网络将会消失。
complete:1.hook: Dawn was forty minutes away, and the last point was moving.
complete:1.line: 'You cannot stop me — I will *complete* the circuit first.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on the open channel.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音穿过开放频道的静电噪音。

sentences.en: 'The grid map is not yours yet,' he said.
sentences.cn: "网格地图还不是你的，"他说。

sentences.en: I looked at the seven marked corners on my scanner — six were confirmed, one still dark.
sentences.cn: 我看着扫描仪上标记的七个角——六个已确认，一个还是黑的。

sentences.en: I had to *complete* the circuit before dawn or the whole network would reset and vanish.

measure:1.en: Grey Crow knelt on the wet pavement and pressed a thin sensor strip against the wall. 'We *measure* the signal depth here every night,' he murmured. 'Last night it doubled.' I checked the reading on his screen. The source was not coming from above the city. It was coming from below.
measure:1.cnHint: 灰鸦每晚____这面墙的信号强度，昨晚数值突然翻倍。
measure:1.hook: Nothing below these streets should be able to broadcast.
measure:1.line: '*Measure* the depth again — that number cannot be right.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow knelt on the wet pavement and pressed a thin sensor strip against the wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦跪在湿润的路面上，把一条薄薄的传感器条贴在了墙上。

sentences.en: 'We *measure* the signal depth here every night,' he murmured.
'Last night it doubled.'
sentences.cn: "昨晚翻了一倍。"

sentences.en: I checked the reading on his screen.
sentences.cn: 我查看了他屏幕上的数据。

sentences.en: The source was not coming from above the city.
sentences.cn: 信号源不是来自城市上空。

sentences.en: It was coming from below.
sentences.cn: 它来自下面。

recommend:1.en: Ali pulled me aside at the corner where Canal Road met the dark market strip. 'I *recommend* you avoid the south gate tonight,' she said, her voice barely above the rain. She slipped a folded note into my coat pocket and walked away fast without looking back. I opened the note. One word: RUN.
recommend:1.cnHint: 阿栗____我今晚别走南门，随即递给我一张只写着一个词的纸条。
recommend:1.hook: The word on the note was already fading, as if the ink feared light.
recommend:1.line: 'I *recommend* you trust me on this — just once.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled me aside at the corner where Canal Road met the dark market strip.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在运河路和黑市街交汇的角落把我拉到了一边。

sentences.en: 'I *recommend* you avoid the south gate tonight,' she said, her voice barely above the rain.
She slipped a folded note into my coat pocket and walked away fast without looking back.
sentences.cn: 她在我外套口袋里塞了张折好的纸条，然后快步走开，头也没回。

sentences.en: I opened the note.
sentences.cn: 我打开了纸条。

sentences.en: One word: RUN.
sentences.cn: 就一个词：逃。

resource:1.en: The broadcast tower on Pier Nine was locked, but Grey Crow knew a side hatch. 'Every hidden network needs a *resource* like this,' he said, patting the rusted antenna frame. 'Power, reach, silence.' I plugged in the relay and watched the signal bar climb. Then an alarm I had never heard before began to sound.
resource:1.cnHint: 灰鸦说每个秘密网络都需要像这座天线塔这样的____。
resource:1.hook: The alarm was not from inside the tower — it was from the pier itself.
resource:1.line: 'This tower is the one *resource* Zero cannot buy or burn.'

sentences.en: The broadcast tower on Pier Nine was locked, but Grey Crow knew a side hatch.
sentences.cn: 九号码头的广播塔被锁着，但灰鸦知道一条侧边的出口。

sentences.en: 'Every hidden network needs a *resource* like this,' he said, patting the rusted antenna frame.
'Power, reach, silence.'
sentences.cn: 权力、覆盖、沉默。

sentences.en: I plugged in the relay and watched the signal bar climb.
sentences.cn: 我插上中继器，看着信号条爬升。

sentences.en: Then an alarm I had never heard before began to sound.
sentences.cn: 然后一阵我从没听过的警报声开始尖鸣。

specific:1.en: Zero's message arrived as light-coded dots on the wet road, projected from somewhere high and unseen. The pattern gave a *specific* corner — not a district, not a block, but one exact crossing: Canal and Fifth, lamp three. I stood there in the rain reading it twice. He wanted me at that spot. Why me, why now?
specific:1.cnHint: 零点用光点投影给出了一个____的地点，就是第五街路口的第三盏灯下。
specific:1.hook: The lamp above me flickered, and I realised I was already standing under it.
specific:1.line: 'The message is *specific* — he means you, not Grey Crow.'

sentences.en: Zero's message arrived as light-coded dots on the wet road, projected from somewhere high and unseen.
sentences.cn: 零点的消息以光编码的点阵形式出现在湿漉漉的道路上，从某个高处无人之地投射下来。

sentences.en: The pattern gave a *specific* corner — not a district, not a block, but one exact crossing: Canal and Fifth, lamp three.
I stood there in the rain reading it twice.
sentences.cn: 我站在雨里读了两遍。

sentences.en: He wanted me at that spot.
sentences.cn: 他要我去那个地点。

sentences.en: Why me, why now?
sentences.cn: 为什么是我，为什么是现在？

major:1.en: The rain never stopped in Harbor City. I stood at the edge of Neon Row, where three underground networks crossed. Grey Crow had warned me: this corner held a *major* secret, one that could bring down Zero's entire operation. I pulled my coat tight and listened for the signal buried in the static.
major:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，这个路口隐藏着一个____的秘密，足以瓦解零点的行动。
major:1.hook: Then the static broke, and a voice said my name.
major:1.line: 'This is a *major* crossing — one wrong step and it all ends.'

sentences.en: The rain never stopped in Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 港城的雨从不停歇。

sentences.en: I stood at the edge of Neon Row, where three underground networks crossed.
sentences.cn: 我站在霓虹街的边缘，三条地下网络在这里交汇。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: this corner held a *major* secret, one that could bring down Zero's entire operation.
I pulled my coat tight and listened for the signal buried in the static.
sentences.cn: 我拉紧外套，耳朵捕捉静电噪音里埋藏的信号。

communication:1.en: Ali met me under the broken overpass, her eyes scanning the wet street. She handed me a small device no bigger than a coin. 'Zero has cut every normal *communication* line in this district,' she whispered. 'This is the only channel left.' The device felt warm, as if it were already alive.
communication:1.cnHint: 阿栗给了我一个小设备，因为零点已经切断了这一区所有正常的____线路。
communication:1.hook: The device blinked once, then went cold and dark.
communication:1.line: 'Every *communication* line is dead — trust only this.'

sentences.en: Ali met me under the broken overpass, her eyes scanning the wet street.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在破损的高架桥下面和我碰面，眼睛扫过湿润的街道。

sentences.en: She handed me a small device no bigger than a coin.
sentences.cn: 她递给我一个不比硬币大的小装置。

sentences.en: 'Zero has cut every normal *communication* line in this district,' she whispered.
'This is the only channel left.'
sentences.cn: 这是仅存的通道。

sentences.en: The device felt warm, as if it were already alive.
sentences.cn: 装置摸起来温热，好像已经活了似的。

market:1.en: The old night *market* on Canal Street was still open, stalls packed with stolen data chips and fake ID cards. I moved through the crowd slowly, searching for the contact Grey Crow had named. Smoke from cheap food carts hung low, masking faces and voices. Somewhere in this noise, Zero had a spy watching me.
market:1.cnHint: 我在运河街的夜____里寻找灰鸦提到的联系人，但零点的眼线也在人群中盯着我。
market:1.hook: A hand closed around my wrist from behind.
market:1.line: 'In this *market*, every face is either a buyer or a trap.'

sentences.en: The old night *market* on Canal Street was still open, stalls packed with stolen data chips and fake ID cards.
I moved through the crowd slowly, searching for the contact Grey Crow had named.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓穿过人群，寻找灰鸦提过的联系人。

sentences.en: Smoke from cheap food carts hung low, masking faces and voices.
sentences.cn: 便宜餐车的烟雾笼罩得很低，遮住了脸和声音。

sentences.en: Somewhere in this noise, Zero had a spy watching me.
sentences.cn: 在这片噪音里的某个地方，零点有间谍在盯着我。

apply:1.en: Grey Crow crouched beside me behind a rusted fence, pressing a thin patch onto the signal tower's base. 'You have to *apply* this to the metal directly,' he said, his voice flat and quick. 'It will mask our trace for exactly four minutes.' Four minutes to do everything. Four minutes before Zero knew we were here.
apply:1.cnHint: 灰鸦让我把一块薄片直接____在金属上，这样我们的踪迹才能被隐藏四分钟。
apply:1.hook: Four minutes started the moment the patch touched steel.
apply:1.line: '*Apply* it now — we lose the window in seconds.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow crouched beside me behind a rusted fence, pressing a thin patch onto the signal tower's base.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在我身边一堵生锈的栅栏后面，在信号塔底部贴上一块薄片。

sentences.en: 'You have to *apply* this to the metal directly,' he said, his voice flat and quick.
'It will mask our trace for exactly four minutes.'
sentences.cn: 它会掩盖我们的踪迹，恰好四分钟。

sentences.en: Four minutes to do everything.
sentences.cn: 四分钟完成所有事。

sentences.en: Four minutes before Zero knew we were here.
sentences.cn: 四分钟后零点就会知道我们在这里。

per:1.en: Zero's network charged one data token *per* message sent through the city grid. It sounded small. But Ali showed me the numbers: ten million messages a night, all taxed, all tracked, all feeding one account. The street vendors, the students, the workers — every word they sent made Zero richer and more powerful.
per:1.cnHint: 零点的网络对每条信息按____收取一个数据代币，阿栗向我展示了这背后惊人的数字。
per:1.hook: Someone had started counting the cost — and they wanted it stopped.
per:1.line: 'One token *per* message — that is how he owns this city.'

sentences.en: Zero's network charged one data token *per* message sent through the city grid.
It sounded small.
sentences.cn: 听起来很小。

sentences.en: But Ali showed me the numbers: ten million messages a night, all taxed, all tracked, all feeding one account.
sentences.cn: 但阿栗给我看了数字：每晚一千万条消息，全都被征税，全都被追踪，全都流向一个账户。

sentences.en: The street vendors, the students, the workers — every word they sent made Zero richer and more powerful.
sentences.cn: 街边小贩、学生、工人——他们发出的每个字都让零点变得更富有、更强大。

treat:1.en: I found the injured courier slumped against a cold wall in Pipe Alley. Someone had gone through his bag and left him there. Ali knelt beside him, her face tight with anger. 'Look how they *treat* people who carry the truth,' she said quietly. He opened his eyes and pressed a folded note into my hand.
treat:1.cnHint: 阿栗看着受伤的信使愤怒地说，看看他们如何____传递真相的人。
treat:1.hook: The note in my hand had only one word on it: Run.
treat:1.line: 'See how they *treat* anyone who knows too much.'

sentences.en: I found the injured courier slumped against a cold wall in Pipe Alley.
sentences.cn: 我在管道巷的冷墙边发现了受伤的信使，他靠在墙上。

sentences.en: Someone had gone through his bag and left him there.
sentences.cn: 有人翻过他的包，把他留在了这里。

sentences.en: Ali knelt beside him, her face tight with anger.
sentences.cn: 阿栗跪在他身边，脸绷得很紧，满是愤怒。

sentences.en: 'Look how they *treat* people who carry the truth,' she said quietly.
He opened his eyes and pressed a folded note into my hand.
sentences.cn: 他睁开眼睛，把一张折叠的纸条塞进我手里。

creative:1.en: Zero's coded graffiti covered the walls of the lower district, but this new tag was different — layered, strange, almost beautiful. Grey Crow studied it in silence. 'Whoever left this is *creative*,' he said, 'and dangerous.' The tag was not a threat. It was a map. And it pointed directly to the place I feared most.
creative:1.cnHint: 灰鸦盯着新的涂鸦说，留下这个的人非常____，而且很危险——那其实是一张地图。
creative:1.hook: The map ended at a door I had promised never to open.
creative:1.line: 'Only someone *creative* could hide a map inside a threat.'

sentences.en: Zero's coded graffiti covered the walls of the lower district, but this new tag was different — layered, strange, almost beautiful.
sentences.cn: 零点的密码涂鸦覆盖了下城区的墙壁，但这个新标签不一样——分层的、诡异的、几乎很漂亮。

sentences.en: Grey Crow studied it in silence.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦沉默地研究着它。

sentences.en: 'Whoever left this is *creative*,' he said, 'and dangerous.'
The tag was not a threat.
sentences.cn: 这标签不是威胁。

sentences.en: It was a map.
sentences.cn: 这是一张地图。

sentences.en: And it pointed directly to the place I feared most.
sentences.cn: 指向我最害怕的地方。

perform:1.en: At the edge of Spark Plaza, a street musician played a broken instrument for a small crowd. Ali touched my arm. 'Watch,' she said. Each note he chose to *perform* was a signal — a live broadcast hidden inside music, sent to every receiver in the district. The crowd clapped. None of them knew they were listening to stolen data.
perform:1.cnHint: 街头乐手演奏的每一个音符都是信号，他在____音乐的同时，向全区发送着被盗数据。
perform:1.hook: Then the musician looked straight at me and stopped playing.
perform:1.line: 'He does not *perform* for the crowd — he performs for Zero.'

sentences.en: At the edge of Spark Plaza, a street musician played a broken instrument for a small crowd.
sentences.cn: 在火花广场的边缘，一个街头音乐人用一件破损的乐器为一小群人演奏。

sentences.en: Ali touched my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗碰了碰我的胳膊。

sentences.en: 'Watch,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，看。

sentences.en: Each note he chose to *perform* was a signal — a live broadcast hidden inside music, sent to every receiver in the district.
The crowd clapped.
sentences.cn: 人群鼓掌。

sentences.en: None of them knew they were listening to stolen data.
sentences.cn: 他们都不知道自己在听被盗的数据。

policy:2.en: Deep inside the Harbor City data vault, I found a cracked terminal. On the screen: a single document titled ZERO PROTOCOL. It outlined a *policy* — no citizen could send encrypted text without city approval. Ali had warned me. Now I understood why half the underground was silent.
policy:2.cnHint: 我在数据库深处发现了一份管控加密通讯的____文件。
policy:2.hook: Someone had already opened the file — three minutes ago.
policy:2.line: 'This *policy* kills every free voice in Harbor City,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Deep inside the Harbor City data vault, I found a cracked terminal.
sentences.cn: 在港城数据库的深处，我找到了一台裂纹的终端。

sentences.en: On the screen: a single document titled ZERO PROTOCOL.
sentences.cn: 屏幕上：一份单独的文件，标题是零点协议。

sentences.en: It outlined a *policy* — no citizen could send encrypted text without city approval.
Ali had warned me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗早就警告过我。

sentences.en: Now I understood why half the underground was silent.
sentences.cn: 现在我明白了为什么一半的地下组织都沉默了。

industry:2.en: The old port district smelled of rust and burnt wire. Grey Crow met me at a broken gate. 'Zero owns this block,' he said quietly. Every warehouse here fed the signal-black market — a shadow *industry* built on stolen words. I pulled out my recorder and pressed start.
industry:2.cnHint: 格雷·克罗带我来到港口区，揭露了一个靠贩卖禁语运转的地下____。
industry:2.hook: One warehouse still had its lights on.
industry:2.line: 'An *industry* built on stolen words never stays quiet for long.'

sentences.en: The old port district smelled of rust and burnt wire.
sentences.cn: 老港口区闻起来像生锈和焦灼的电线。

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me at a broken gate.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一扇破损的铁门前见了我。

sentences.en: 'Zero owns this block,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "零点控制这个街区，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: Every warehouse here fed the signal-black market — a shadow *industry* built on stolen words.
I pulled out my recorder and pressed start.
sentences.cn: 我掏出录音机按下了开始键。

concern:2.en: Ali slid a folded note across the wet café table without looking at me. Inside, three words: ZERO KNOWS YOU. My *concern* was not for myself — it was for Grey Crow, who had no idea he was already being watched. I stood up and walked fast.
concern:2.cnHint: 阿里递来一张纸条，我最大的____不是自己，而是毫不知情的格雷·克罗。
concern:2.hook: Outside, a shadow matched my exact pace.
concern:2.line: 'My only *concern* right now is getting Grey Crow out safely.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded note across the wet café table without looking at me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在湿漉漉的咖啡馆桌子上滑过来一张折叠的纸条，头也不看我一眼。

sentences.en: Inside, three words: ZERO KNOWS YOU.
sentences.cn: 纸条里三个字：零点知道你。

sentences.en: My *concern* was not for myself — it was for Grey Crow, who had no idea he was already being watched.
I stood up and walked fast.
sentences.cn: 我站起来快步走出去。

present:2.en: The package arrived at my door with no sender name — just a small metal case. *Present* inside: a chip the size of a fingernail, warm to the touch. Grey Crow had once described a chip like this as the key to Zero's broadcast tower. I did not open it yet.
present:2.cnHint: 门口出现了一个神秘包裹，里面的____可能是打开零点广播塔的钥匙。
present:2.hook: The chip blinked once, then went dark.
present:2.line: 'Treat that *present* carefully — it holds more than data,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The package arrived at my door with no sender name — just a small metal case.
sentences.cn: 包裹出现在我门口，没有寄件人的名字——只有一个小金属盒子。

sentences.en: *Present* inside: a chip the size of a fingernail, warm to the touch.
Grey Crow had once described a chip like this as the key to Zero's broadcast tower.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾经形容过这样的芯片，说它是进入零点广播塔的钥匙。

sentences.en: I did not open it yet.
sentences.cn: 我还没打开它。

claim:2.en: Zero's voice cut through every speaker on Level Nine. 'The city is safe,' it said. Then it began to *claim* that all underground signals were enemy noise — lies dressed as news. Ali grabbed my arm. We both knew the truth was buried somewhere in the old print archive.
claim:2.cnHint: 零点通过广播____所有地下信号都是敌对噪声，而真相藏在旧档案馆里。
claim:2.hook: The archive doors were sealed from the inside.
claim:2.line: 'Zero will *claim* anything to keep people afraid,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through every speaker on Level Nine.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音穿过九层所有的扬声器。

sentences.en: 'The city is safe,' it said.
sentences.cn: "城市很安全，"它说。

sentences.en: Then it began to *claim* that all underground signals were enemy noise — lies dressed as news.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的胳膊。

sentences.en: We both knew the truth was buried somewhere in the old print archive.
sentences.cn: 我们都知道真相埋在旧的纸质档案库里。

half:2.en: The message was cut — *half* the text burned away by an acid tag someone had sprayed over the screen. What remained pointed to a meet at Pier 7. Grey Crow read the broken words slowly. Even half a message from this source was worth more than a full one from anyone else.
half:2.cnHint: 屏幕上的信息只剩____，但格雷·克罗说残余内容已经足够重要。
half:2.hook: Pier 7 was supposed to be underwater.
half:2.line: '*Half* a message from Zero is still enough to trap us,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The message was cut — *half* the text burned away by an acid tag someone had sprayed over the screen.
What remained pointed to a meet at Pier 7.
sentences.cn: 剩下的部分指向七号码头的一场会面。

sentences.en: Grey Crow read the broken words slowly.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦缓缓读着那些残破的字。

sentences.en: Even half a message from this source was worth more than a full one from anyone else.
sentences.cn: 即使来自这个消息源的半条信息也比别人的整条值钱。

successful:2.en: Ali had tried four times to crack the relay node. Each attempt failed with a cold red flash. On the fifth try, silence — then a soft green glow. She looked at me and nodded. A *successful* break-in meant we could hear every coded signal Zero sent for the next hour.
successful:2.cnHint: 阿里第五次尝试终于____入侵了中继节点，我们只有一小时的监听窗口。
successful:2.hook: The first signal we caught was our own names.
successful:2.line: 'A *successful* hack means nothing if we cannot read what we find.'

sentences.en: Ali had tried four times to crack the relay node.
sentences.cn: 阿栗试过四次破解中继节点。

sentences.en: Each attempt failed with a cold red flash.
sentences.cn: 每一次都以冷冰冰的红光失败。

sentences.en: On the fifth try, silence — then a soft green glow.
sentences.cn: 第五次尝试，沉寂——然后一道柔和的绿光。

sentences.en: She looked at me and nodded.
sentences.cn: 她看着我点了点头。

sentences.en: A *successful* break-in meant we could hear every coded signal Zero sent for the next hour.

access:2.en: The corridor was dark except for a blinking lock panel. Grey Crow pressed a cracked card against it. Nothing. He tried a second card — a thin strip of copper tape. The panel turned blue. '*Access* granted,' it whispered in a voice that did not belong to the city system. We stepped through.
access:2.cnHint: 格雷·克罗用一张特制铜片获得了____，但那把声音不属于城市系统。
access:2.hook: The corridor stretched further than the map showed.
access:2.line: '*Access* to this level means Zero already knew we were coming.'

sentences.en: The corridor was dark except for a blinking lock panel.
sentences.cn: 走廊里一片黑暗，只有一盏闪烁的锁面板。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a cracked card against it.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一张裂纹卡片贴在上面。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.cn: 没反应。

sentences.en: He tried a second card — a thin strip of copper tape.
sentences.cn: 他试了第二张卡——一条细细的铜箔条。

sentences.en: The panel turned blue. '*Access* granted,' it whispered in a voice that did not belong to the city system.
We stepped through.
sentences.cn: 我们走了进去。

trouble:1.en: Rain hammered the streets of Harbor City. I spotted Grey Crow near a broken signal post, his coat soaked dark. 'You found me,' he said quietly. 'That means *trouble* found you too.' Somewhere behind us, a door slammed. Ali grabbed my arm. The coded graffiti on the wall had changed since yesterday.
trouble:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在信号柱旁警告我，____已经跟上了我。
trouble:1.hook: The graffiti now spelled out my name.
trouble:1.line: 'That means *trouble* found you too,' Grey Crow said, eyes on the wall.

sentences.en: Rain hammered the streets of Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在港口城的街道上。

sentences.en: I spotted Grey Crow near a broken signal post, his coat soaked dark.
sentences.cn: 我在一根断裂的信号柱附近发现了灰鸦，他的外套被浸成了深色。

sentences.en: 'You found me,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "你找到我了，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'That means *trouble* found you too.'
Somewhere behind us, a door slammed.
sentences.cn: 我们身后某处传来一声门的碰撞声。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的胳膊。

sentences.en: The coded graffiti on the wall had changed since yesterday.
sentences.cn: 墙上的涂鸦代码从昨天起就变了。

reflect:1.en: Puddles covered the cracked pavement outside the old transit hub. I stopped walking. The neon signs above *reflected* in the water below, but one reflection was wrong — it showed a word that the real sign did not. Ali crouched beside me and whispered, 'Someone is rewriting what we see.'
reflect:1.cnHint: 路面积水____出一个现实中不存在的词，阿里低声提醒了我。
reflect:1.hook: The false word in the water blinked once, then vanished.
reflect:1.line: 'Look — the sign *reflects* something that isn't really there,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Puddles covered the cracked pavement outside the old transit hub.
sentences.cn: 裂纹铺装路面外面积满了水洼。

sentences.en: I stopped walking.
sentences.cn: 我停下了脚步。

sentences.en: The neon signs above *reflected* in the water below, but one reflection was wrong — it showed a word that the real sign did not.
Ali crouched beside me and whispered, 'Someone is rewriting what we see.'
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在我身边低声说，"有人在改写我们看到的东西。"

attend:1.en: Grey Crow had told me to *attend* a street-corner broadcast at midnight — the kind only rookies and fools show up for. I came anyway. Zero was already there, leaning on a rail, watching me with flat eyes. The broadcast crackled and then went silent. We were the only two left.
attend:1.cnHint: 灰鸦让我____一个午夜街角广播，但零也出现在那里。
attend:1.hook: Zero smiled and said, 'I knew you could not stay away.'
attend:1.line: 'You actually chose to *attend* this broadcast,' Zero said, voice flat.

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me to *attend* a street-corner broadcast at midnight — the kind only rookies and fools show up for.
I came anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是去了。

sentences.en: Zero was already there, leaning on a rail, watching me with flat eyes.
sentences.cn: 零点已经在那儿了，靠在栏杆上，用毫无生气的眼睛看着我。

sentences.en: The broadcast crackled and then went silent.
sentences.cn: 广播嘎吱一声然后沉默了。

sentences.en: We were the only two left.
sentences.cn: 只有我们两个人留下来了。

belief:1.en: Ali and I stood under a flickering overpass. She pressed a small chip into my hand. 'My *belief* is that Grey Crow is still alive,' she said, steady as stone. The chip held a single encrypted frequency. Rain tapped on the metal above us like slow fingers counting down to something neither of us wanted to name.
belief:1.cnHint: 阿里把芯片交给我，表达了她对灰鸦还活着的____。
belief:1.hook: The frequency on the chip matched the one Zero had jammed.
belief:1.line: 'My *belief* is that Grey Crow is still alive,' Ali said firmly.

sentences.en: Ali and I stood under a flickering overpass.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我站在一条闪烁的高架桥下。

sentences.en: She pressed a small chip into my hand.
sentences.cn: 她把一个小芯片按进了我的手心。

sentences.en: 'My *belief* is that Grey Crow is still alive,' she said, steady as stone.
The chip held a single encrypted frequency.
sentences.cn: 芯片里存着一条加密频率。

sentences.en: Rain tapped on the metal above us like slow fingers counting down to something neither of us wanted to name.
sentences.cn: 雨点敲打着头顶的金属，像缓缓的手指在倒计时什么我们都不想说出来的东西。

carry:1.en: The market alley was loud and wet. Zero stepped out from behind a stall, hands open, looking harmless. I knew better. Grey Crow had once warned me: anyone willing to *carry* a message through a jammed zone carries something far more dangerous too. I kept my eyes on Zero's coat pocket and did not move.
carry:1.cnHint: 零出现在市场巷口，而灰鸦曾警告过我，敢____信息穿越干扰区的人绝不简单。
carry:1.hook: Zero's pocket moved — something inside it was still alive.
carry:1.line: 'Only the brave *carry* messages through a jammed zone,' Zero said softly.

sentences.en: The market alley was loud and wet.
sentences.cn: 市场小巷又吵又湿。

sentences.en: Zero stepped out from behind a stall, hands open, looking harmless.
sentences.cn: 零点从一个摊位后面走出来，两手空空，看起来无害。

sentences.en: I knew better.
sentences.cn: 我知道得更清楚。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had once warned me: anyone willing to *carry* a message through a jammed zone carries something far more dangerous too.
I kept my eyes on Zero's coat pocket and did not move.
sentences.cn: 我的眼睛盯着零点的大衣口袋，一动不动。

else:1.en: Every exit from the plaza was blocked by static-tag drones. I ran the options fast: rooftop, sewer, freight line. All dead. Ali's voice cracked through my earpiece — 'Think of something *else*, and think fast.' The drones were tightening their circle. Somewhere in the noise, I heard Grey Crow's signal, faint and steady.
else:1.cnHint: 广场出口全被封锁，阿里催促我想____办法，就在此时灰鸦的信号若隐若现。
else:1.hook: Grey Crow's signal pulsed once — then cut to silence.
else:1.line: 'Think of something *else*, and think fast,' Ali urged in my ear.

sentences.en: Every exit from the plaza was blocked by static-tag drones.
sentences.cn: 广场的每个出口都被静态标签无人机堵死了。

sentences.en: I ran the options fast: rooftop, sewer, freight line.
sentences.cn: 我快速权衡了选项：天台、下水道、货运线。

sentences.en: All dead.
sentences.cn: 全都死路。

sentences.en: Ali's voice cracked through my earpiece — 'Think of something *else*, and think fast.'
The drones were tightening their circle.
sentences.cn: 无人机的包围圈在缩小。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the noise, I heard Grey Crow's signal, faint and steady.
sentences.cn: 在噪音中某处，我听到了灰鸦的信号，微弱而稳定。

positive:2.en: I found the message tucked under a broken street lamp in the old port district. The ink was still wet. Grey Crow had told me to watch for signs, and this one was *positive*: a circle with an arrow pointing up. Someone wanted us to move forward, not retreat.
positive:2.cnHint: 我在旧港区的路灯下发现一张字条，灰鸦说这个符号是____的信号。
positive:2.hook: But the ink smelled wrong — like a trap freshly set.
positive:2.line: 'This sign is *positive*, so we move now,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: I found the message tucked under a broken street lamp in the old port district.
sentences.cn: 我在旧港口区一盏破损的街灯下找到了那条信息。

sentences.en: The ink was still wet.
sentences.cn: 墨迹还没干。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me to watch for signs, and this one was *positive*: a circle with an arrow pointing up.
Someone wanted us to move forward, not retreat.
sentences.cn: 有人要我们向前，不是后退。

economic:2.en: Zero had left a torn page on the bench outside the old exchange building. It listed numbers — trade routes, power costs, server fees. Ali leaned over my shoulder and whispered that the data mapped every *economic* nerve of Harbor City. Whoever held this page held the city itself.
economic:2.cnHint: 零点留下了一张记录着Harbor City____命脉数据的纸页。
economic:2.hook: One number was circled in red, and I had no idea why.
economic:2.line: 'Every *economic* line here leads to the same name,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Zero had left a torn page on the bench outside the old exchange building.
sentences.cn: 零点在旧交易所外的长椅上留下了一张撕破的纸页。

sentences.en: It listed numbers — trade routes, power costs, server fees.
sentences.cn: 上面列满了数字——贸易路线、电力成本、服务器费用。

sentences.en: Ali leaned over my shoulder and whispered that the data mapped every *economic* nerve of Harbor City.
Whoever held this page held the city itself.
sentences.cn: 谁拿到这张纸，谁就掌控了整个港口城市。

link:2.en: Deep in the signal archive beneath the transit hub, I found a chip no larger than a fingernail. Grey Crow had once said every hidden network needs one weak *link* — and this chip was it. Pull it, and the whole coded broadcast grid would go silent in seconds.
link:2.cnHint: 我在中转站地下档案室找到一枚芯片，它是整个广播网络的关键____。
link:2.hook: My fingers froze just before I touched it.
link:2.line: 'That chip is the *link* we have been hunting,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Deep in the signal archive beneath the transit hub, I found a chip no larger than a fingernail.
sentences.cn: 在中转枢纽下面的信号库深处，我找到了一块指甲大小的芯片。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had once said every hidden network needs one weak *link* — and this chip was it.
Pull it, and the whole coded broadcast grid would go silent in seconds.
sentences.cn: 拔掉它，整个编码广播网在几秒内就会陷入沉默。

produce:2.en: The old print shop near the canal was dark and smelled of oil. Ali found the hidden press in the back room. Zero had used it to *produce* thousands of coded leaflets, each one carrying a signal buried in plain words. The pile on the floor was still warm.
produce:2.cnHint: 阿栗在运河边的印刷店发现了零点用来____传单的暗处印刷机。
produce:2.hook: A shadow moved behind the curtain at the far end of the room.
produce:2.line: 'He used this machine to *produce* every false signal we chased,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The old print shop near the canal was dark and smelled of oil.
sentences.cn: 运河边那家老印刷厂又黑又闻得到油味。

sentences.en: Ali found the hidden press in the back room.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在后室找到了隐藏的印刷机。

sentences.en: Zero had used it to *produce* thousands of coded leaflets, each one carrying a signal buried in plain words.
The pile on the floor was still warm.
sentences.cn: 地板上的那堆纸张还是热的。

teach:2.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway off the night market and held up a small card covered in symbols. 'I am going to *teach* you the one code Zero cannot change,' she said quietly. Each symbol matched a sound, and together they spelled out a location I had never heard of.
teach:2.cnHint: 灰鸦拉着我躲进小巷，说要____我一种零点无法破解的密码。
teach:2.hook: The location on that card did not exist on any city map.
teach:2.line: 'Let me *teach* you this before Zero finds us,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway off the night market and held up a small card covered in symbols.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉进夜市一条街道的门洞里，举起一张满是符号的小卡片。

sentences.en: 'I am going to *teach* you the one code Zero cannot change,' she said quietly.
Each symbol matched a sound, and together they spelled out a location I had never heard of.
sentences.cn: 每个符号对应一个音，组合在一起指向一个我从未听说过的地方。

worth:2.en: Inside the locker at the mid-city relay station I found a small glass drive. Ali had risked everything to leave it there. The files on it were *worth* more than any reward Zero had ever posted — they were raw proof, names, dates, the whole hidden structure laid bare.
worth:2.cnHint: 我在中转站的储物柜里找到了阿栗冒险藏下的玻璃驱动器，其中的文件____连城。
worth:2.hook: The locker behind mine had been forced open and emptied.
worth:2.line: 'This drive is *worth* every risk we took tonight,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Inside the locker at the mid-city relay station I found a small glass drive.
sentences.cn: 在中城中继站的储物柜里，我找到了一个小玻璃盘。

sentences.en: Ali had risked everything to leave it there.
sentences.cn: 阿栗冒着生命危险把它留在那里。

sentences.en: The files on it were *worth* more than any reward Zero had ever posted — they were raw proof, names, dates, the whole hidden structure laid bare.

common:2.en: The graffiti tag appeared on three walls across different districts — the harbor, the tower block, the old school. At first it looked like street art, but Grey Crow showed me the *common* thread running through each image: the same hidden glyph, repeating, waiting to be read.
common:2.cnHint: 三处涂鸦看似无关，但灰鸦发现了其中____的隐藏符文。
common:2.hook: The glyph pointed to one building that no longer officially existed.
common:2.line: 'Look for the *common* mark — that is how Zero speaks,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The graffiti tag appeared on three walls across different districts — the harbor, the tower block, the old school.
sentences.cn: 涂鸦标签出现在三堵不同地区的墙上——港口、塔楼、老学校。

sentences.en: At first it looked like street art, but Grey Crow showed me the *common* thread running through each image: the same hidden glyph, repeating, waiting to be read.

daily:2.en: Ali handed me a folded sheet pulled from a public notice board near the west gate. It looked like a routine bulletin — weather, transit times, curfew hours. But the *daily* update column held a second layer of text, visible only under the violet light of my scanner. Zero had been broadcasting in plain sight.
daily:2.cnHint: 阿栗发现公告栏上的____更新栏里隐藏着零点用紫外光才能看到的秘密信息。
daily:2.hook: Today's message was addressed to my name.
daily:2.line: 'Zero hides inside the *daily* noise where no one looks,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali handed me a folded sheet pulled from a public notice board near the west gate.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一张从西门附近的公告栏撕下来的折叠纸。

sentences.en: It looked like a routine bulletin — weather, transit times, curfew hours.
sentences.cn: 看起来像是常规公告——天气、交通时间、宵禁。

sentences.en: But the *daily* update column held a second layer of text, visible only under the violet light of my scanner.
Zero had been broadcasting in plain sight.
sentences.cn: 零点一直在光天化日之下广播。

determine:2.en: Deep in the archive vault beneath Pier Nine, I found a cracked data chip half-buried in dust. Grey Crow had told me its serial code would *determine* whether Zero's network was still live. I wiped the chip clean and slotted it in. The reader hummed. Numbers rolled across my visor.
determine:2.cnHint: 我在档案库中发现了一枚芯片，试图用它____零点的网络是否仍在运行。
determine:2.hook: The last digit locked — and matched the code I was never meant to see.
determine:2.line: 'This code will *determine* everything we do next,' Grey Crow said softly.

sentences.en: Deep in the archive vault beneath Pier Nine, I found a cracked data chip half-buried in dust.
sentences.cn: 在九号码头下面的档案库深处，我找到了一块半埋在灰尘里的破裂数据芯片。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me its serial code would *determine* whether Zero's network was still live.
I wiped the chip clean and slotted it in.
sentences.cn: 我擦干了芯片，插了进去。

sentences.en: The reader hummed.
sentences.cn: 读取器发出嗡鸣。

sentences.en: Numbers rolled across my visor.
sentences.cn: 数字在我的显示器上滚动。

response:2.en: Ali slid a folded note under the door of the safe house just past midnight. It carried a single question in cipher: are you still on our side? I waited by the dim lamp for an hour. No *response* came from the other end of the wire. Outside, rain hammered the steel roof.
response:2.cnHint: 阿栗送来一张密语纸条，但那边始终没有给出____。
response:2.hook: Then the lamp flickered once — a signal no one should have known.
response:2.line: 'No *response* means they already know we are here,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded note under the door of the safe house just past midnight.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在午夜刚过时从安全屋的门下塞进一张折叠便条。

sentences.en: It carried a single question in cipher: are you still on our side?
sentences.cn: 上面用密码写着一个问题：你还站在我们这边吗？

sentences.en: I waited by the dim lamp for an hour.
sentences.cn: 我在昏暗的灯下等了一小时。

sentences.en: No *response* came from the other end of the wire.
Outside, rain hammered the steel roof.
sentences.cn: 外面，雨敲打着钢制屋顶。

search:2.en: The order came through on a cracked frequency at dawn: full *search* of Block Seven, every room, every cabinet. I had four minutes to move the evidence case before the officers reached the third floor. My boots barely made a sound on the wet tile as I slipped into the stairwell.
search:2.cnHint: 当局展开全面____，我只有四分钟转移证据。
search:2.hook: A beam of light swept under the door — they were already on my floor.
search:2.line: 'The *search* reaches this room in three minutes,' Grey Crow breathed.

sentences.en: The order came through on a cracked frequency at dawn: full *search* of Block Seven, every room, every cabinet.
I had four minutes to move the evidence case before the officers reached the third floor.
sentences.cn: 在警察到达三楼前，我只有四分钟时间转移证物箱。

sentences.en: My boots barely made a sound on the wet tile as I slipped into the stairwell.
sentences.cn: 我的靴子在湿瓷砖上几乎无声，滑进了楼梯间。

due:2.en: The transit manifest on the desk showed a cargo pod *due* to arrive at Bay Four before sunrise. Ali had circled the entry in red. Inside that pod, according to our source, was the one device that could crack Zero's broadcast key. I grabbed my coat and headed for the docks.
due:2.cnHint: 一份货运清单显示，关键设备____在天亮前抵达Bay Four。
due:2.hook: Bay Four was dark when I arrived — the pod was already gone.
due:2.line: 'It was *due* an hour ago; something stopped it,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The transit manifest on the desk showed a cargo pod *due* to arrive at Bay Four before sunrise.
Ali had circled the entry in red.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用红笔圈了这条记录。

sentences.en: Inside that pod, according to our source, was the one device that could crack Zero's broadcast key.
sentences.cn: 根据线人的消息，那个舱里装的是唯一能破解零点广播密钥的装置。

sentences.en: I grabbed my coat and headed for the docks.
sentences.cn: 我抓起外套，冲向码头。

regard:2.en: Grey Crow stood at the rain-streaked window and *regarded* the small metal box on the table for a long moment, saying nothing. Ali and I watched him. That box had been left at our door with no name, no mark. His silence told me he recognised it — and feared what was inside.
regard:2.cnHint: 灰鸦静静地____着桌上那个无名金属盒，神情凝重。
regard:2.hook: He stepped back slowly, and told us not to touch it.
regard:2.line: 'I *regard* this object as a direct warning,' Grey Crow said at last.

sentences.en: Grey Crow stood at the rain-streaked window and *regarded* the small metal box on the table for a long moment, saying nothing.
Ali and I watched him.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我看着他。

sentences.en: That box had been left at our door with no name, no mark.
sentences.cn: 那个盒子是放在我们门前的，没有名字，没有标记。

sentences.en: His silence told me he recognised it — and feared what was inside.
sentences.cn: 他的沉默告诉我他认出了它——而且害怕里面装的是什么。

true:2.en: Zero's broadcast looped through my earpiece all night: 'Nothing you have found is *true*.' I laid every piece of evidence on the floor of the safe house and studied the pattern. One document broke the chain — a forged timestamp buried in page three. Someone had rewritten the record before we ever arrived.
true:2.cnHint: 零点声称我们掌握的一切都不____，而我发现了一份被篡改的文件。
true:2.hook: The forged date pointed to someone inside our own unit.
true:2.line: 'Tell me which part is *true* and I will believe you,' I said.

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast looped through my earpiece all night: 'Nothing you have found is *true*.'
I laid every piece of evidence on the floor of the safe house and studied the pattern.
sentences.cn: 我把所有的证据铺在安全屋的地板上，研究其中的规律。

sentences.en: One document broke the chain — a forged timestamp buried in page three.
sentences.cn: 有一份文件打破了逻辑链——第三页里藏着一个伪造的时间戳。

sentences.en: Someone had rewritten the record before we ever arrived.
sentences.cn: 我们到达之前，有人已经改写了记录。
